116000.description: Mikoto is a practical girl looking for an after-school job to help support her family. The school principal calls her to his office to offer her a job: help to feed the Health teacher Kairi-sensei. But what does he like to eat?
synonyms: Liar teacher and I, his prey
騙子老師與獵物般的我

title.native: 嘘つき先生と獲物な私
title.romaji: Usotsuki Sensei to Emono na Watashi

116003.description: Madarame is a teacher who has a really strange personality. Whenever she is in trouble or has to make a decision, her minds splits into three parts--a leader, a maiden, and a slob--who argue about the outcome. When her boyfriend breaks up with her, she goes a bit wild. She cuts her hair, and then goes out and gets in a fight, ending up dumped on a pile of trash. At her lowest, one of her students, Sena, rides up on a "white horse" bicycle and takes care of her wounds. Is her student Sena her prince on a white horse, finally come, or is that just ridiculous? Now, Madarame has an absurd crush on her student that she just can't seem to shake.

title.native: 斑目先生の妄想学級日誌
怪談百物語 新耳袋

116007.description:
"When I first laid eyes on you, I bet with myself that you were well-endowed."

Strait-laced office worker Ryota, who is serious to a fault, is forced to accompany his coworkers to a very special club. As he's waiting nervously, the androgynous and alluring receptionist Sho is the one that comes to his room. Ryota, traumatized by a past incident, is resistant to the idea of submission, but falls prey to Sho's domineering skills in the bedroom... Is Ryota just one step away from becoming an obedient puppy!?

(Source: Brite Publishing)

Note: Includes an extra chapter.

title.native: サディスティック・マッドネス

116011.description:
Our protagonist awakes in a house he doesn't know—in fact, not only does he not know where he is, he doesn't know who he is. What he does know is that this unfamiliar house is empty, save for the body (and head) of a decapitated woman—a stranger, he thinks. He’s rescued by a woman, Shio, who calls him "Iori"...but is that who he really is? And when she helps him hide the body without batting an eye, telling him to trust her...can he? Should he?

(Source: Kodansha USA)

116012.description:
Mishka, a young girl who has lost her home and her right arm, finds shelter in the oasis city of Katanar. There she meets a boy named Chato, who is missing his left arm. Mishka and Chato pretend to be twin siblings, and end up finding a job as servants of Indaris, the son of the city's lord, who lies in bed as an abomination...?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

Note: Volume 10 of the Kishibe no Uta series.

Collected Stories:
1. Shinintsukai no Yuigon (死人使いの遺言)
2-3. Suna no Shita no Shirabe (砂の下の調べ)

116013.description:
In this world, there exists four different human races: regular humans called Niers, those who carry genes of beasts of the sky called Vamps, those who carry genes of beasts of the land called Lycans, and those who carry genes of beasts of the water called Sirens. The latter three are called Beasts of Blood (B.O.B.) Haruka is a simple Nier, the most populous of the races. He has grown up with his eccentric father - or rather, Haruka has grown up supporting his eccentric father and his spontaneous endeavors, his most recent surprise in store being marriage to a man with three kids of his own, all similar in age to Haruka. The only difference is that they are all B.O.B.s! Will the naive Nier Haruka survive his world being turned upside down!? Or will he be too dazzled by his new glamorous step-brothers...!?

(Source: Futekiya)
synonyms: ビースト オフ ブラッド

116014.description: Chinese mythical beasts living in modern China.

116017.description:
“Hey, will you go out with me?” A beautiful girl confessed to me. To escape the days of winding around with delinquents, I decided to attend a former girls academy, Anzugaoka High, where I finally got a girlfriend. This is the start of my rose-colored high school life I’ve always dreamed of, or so I thought— “It’s all because I love you, Haru. Isn’t it natural that I want you to belong to me for all of eternity?” Why is it that she is trying to kill me on our first date? You won’t be able to turn your eyes away till the gripping conclusion of this awkward tale of love and murder.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 彼女が俺を暗殺しようとしている
title.romaji: Kanojo ga Ore wo Ansatsu Shiyou to Shiteru

116018.description: Edith disliked archeology, despite having a grandfather who helped excavate the ruins and an older brother who studied ancient Egypt. However, one day before she was to marry a banker, after taking care of the mysterious kitten Lyra, there is a big change in her predictable life ...!?

116019.description:
"The way you're moving makes me think that you want more."
I'm with a man that's not my husband. A man I don't know, who is aggressively touching me in sensitive places, and making me feel things I never have before...! "Ah... no... not there..." My yearning body can't even hide how good it feels... Newly-wed Mika Asukai and a handsome doctor had an arranged marriage. So then, why has Mika asked detective Rei Minegishi for a night together in a love hotel? And why did he say yes...!? And now, Mika can't go back to the days when she thought her life was normal...

A forbidden love experiment for all the women burdened with secrets they can't tell...

(Source: Renta!)
synonyms: 婚外カルテット-探偵と人妻-

title.english: An Extramarital Quartet -The Detective and the Wife-
title.native: 婚外カルテット―探偵と人妻―

116020.description: The servants and Lady Florentina's family noticed that Lady Florentina seems to have love sickness. What is truly going on with her?

116021.description:
A schemer may never know how pure or how devoting that love can be. I may be dominating or calculating; I may lie or cheat. But the only reason behind it all is that I love you more...

(Source: Webnovel)

116023.description: What would the experience of being simultaneously chased by 4 god-like men with weird personalities be like? An ordinary high-school girl, Mo Li, is confessed to by 4 unfamiliar men. When she finally pulls herself together, she finds that these 4 'unfamiliar' men have unexpectedly integrated themselves into her life somehow. So then how will she make her decision on who to choose?

116024.description:
In a world where your value is determined by the amount of equipment slots you're born with, our young protagonist Noroa, who dreams of becoming an adventurer has... zero equipment slots! However, he's able to equip 9999 items only if they are cursed?! His adventure begins a fateful day after meeting a mysterious doll and acquiring a cheat-like cursed sword!

(Source: MANGA UP!)
synonyms: 我的詛咒裝備不可能那麼可愛
我的诅咒装备不可能这么可爱
สุดยอดนักดาบ ไร้ช่องติดอาวุธ แต่ถ้าเป็นของต้องสาป(น่ารัก)ฉันขอจัดเต็ม 999 ช่อง

title.english: The Strongest Swordsman Has Zero Equipment Slots, but He Can Equip up to 9999 Items if It’s (Cute) Cursed Equipment

title.romaji: Sobiwaku Zero no Saikyou Kenshi: demo, Noroi no Sobi (Kawaii) nara 9999-ko Tsuke Hodai

116025.description: In a world where your number of equipment slots determines your status, Noroa found himself with exactly zero slots. Until one day when he found a mysterious doll who told him that he has the ability to equip 9999 pieces of equipment... if they're cursed! Starting with a cheating-powerful cursed sword, Noroa's adventure begins!

title.native: 装備枠ゼロの最強剣士 でも、呪いの装備(可愛い)なら9999個つけ放題

A collection of stories:

1. Yoru no Yasashii Te (夜のやさしい手); Serie Mystery 1994-03

3. Awazu ni Aishite (会わずに愛して); Lady's Comic I 1991-06

にっぽん・ぱらだいす
たとえば白い花の下に

116027.description:
After rebirth, how can this sexy smoking girl told me to be her toy-boy? I'm a master in cultivation! How can I succumb to this world of women? Look at how I fight my own way in this world of women!

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: Immortal Swordsman in the Reverse World

title.english: Sword King In A Women's World
title.romaji: Ben Jian Xian Jue Bu Chi Ruan Fan

116029.description:
A collection of one-shots:
1. Botan Dourou (牡丹灯籠)
2. Yume no Nokoriga (夢の残香)
3. Mou Hitotsu no Yuigon (もうひとつの遺言)
4. Hanayo Koiuta (花夜恋歌)

116030.description:
The sun or the moon. Who do I choose?

Ever since they were little, Se-Un believed that he and his best friend Do-Bin only had each other. But when a rift between them makes room for the newcomer, Dae-Beom, Se-Un’s torn on who to choose: the beautiful but cold Do-Bin, or the warm and inviting Dae-Beom?

(Source: Manta)

116031.description:
Few titles are more revered among horndogs-(ahem) connoisseurs of Japanese erotic video games-than Magical Explorer. One day, our smut-loving hero wakes up to find he has been reincarnated into the body of the game’s dreamboat protagonist! Or rather, his hapless comic-relief best friend, Kousuke Takioto. But with his unparalleled knowledge of Magical Explorer and Kousuke’s unorthodox abilities (a scarf that doubles as a fist?), our hero vows to turn the game’s unluckiest loser into its mightiest heartthrob. In this world, nothing is out of reach when you’ve got the know-how!

(Source: Yen Press)
synonyms: แมจิคัล★เอกซ์พลอเรอร์ เซียนเกมตัวฉกาจจุติมาผงาดในเกมจีบสาว
Reincarnated as a Eroge Hero's Friend, I'll Live Freely with My Eroge Knowledge.
Magical★Explorer - It Seems I Have Become a Friend of the Protagonist in an Eroge World, but Because Magic Is Fun I Have Abandoned the Role and Train Myself
Magical★Explorer: Reborn as a Side Character in a Fantasy Dating Sim

title.romaji: Magical★Explorer: Eroge no Yuujin Chara ni Tensei Shitakedo, Game Chishiki Tsukatte Jiyuu ni Ikiru

title.native: パーフェクト・ジェントルマン

116035.description:
Romantic comedy between a popular idol and an idol otaku!

Rooting for the super popular idol Moco Nanami is the reason for living for 17-year-old idol otaku Sora Amano. Lately, he's been worried because his belongings have been going missing. In the middle of this, Sora pursued and caught a suspicious person that was running away with his smartphone, but the identity of this person is his favorite idol Moco Nanami!?!!?

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

Note: Includes 3 extra chapters.
synonyms: Oshi ga Kounin Sutouka ni Narimashita
My Favorite Idol Officially Became My Stalker!

title.native: 推しが公認ストーカーになりました
title.romaji: Oshi ga Kounin Stalker ni Narimashita
Hikari no Niwa Kaze no Tatsu Kage

title.english: From Delinquent to Bitch with Hypnosis

116049.description:
In a long distance sorta-relationship with his crush, Shouji is crestfallen when weeks of ghosting turns into a confession; his boyfriend just isn't gay. Having struggled with his sexuality for years, Shouji throws himself into his work to distract himself from the rejection, but when a young homeless man called Hama shows up at the shop, Shouji finds himself curious to learn more about him and, hopefully, befriend him.

Attempting to make their way in a society that labels each of them as 'dirty' and 'outcasts', as they grow closer the two men find they have more in common than either of them could have anticipated.

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

116051.description: The story follows Haruo, who one day loses his wife, Hinata, in a car accident. Heart-broken, he one day returns to the manor where his wife lived in order to take care of it. However, this will not be easy, as the manager, Hinata's younger sister, blames him for killing Hinata.

title.native: ひなたに凛と咲くひまわり荘
title.romaji: Hinata ni Rin to Saku Himawarisou

116052.description: Because his cousin is under suspicion of murder, William is trying to find a beautiful woman who was his cousin's recent lover to prove his cousin's alibi. But she disappeared from the house where she should have been. The boy then fell in love with a mysterious blonde woman who wears Chinese dresses. He is trying to find her even though time keeps passing by...

title.native: レディ シノワズリ

116056.description:
Raze was a prodigious priest who supported the legendary Hero. However, he was betrayed by the Hero with his party and sister being killed. He later absorbed the power of the Demon King and now seeks revenge on the Hero and the others that wronged him.

(Source: KADOKAWA, translated)
synonyms: The Servant of God Gets the Power of the Demon King

title.native: 世界最強の復讐神官　〜神に仕えし者、魔王の力を手に入れる〜
title.romaji: Sekai Saikyou no Fukushuu Shinkan: Kami ni Tsukaeshi Mono, Maou no Chikara wo Te ni Ireru

116057.description:
Carrying the baggage of the adventurers and in addition to other miscellaneous tasks in the guild… veteran adventurer Baru is known as a dowdy man who only does simple jobs, but is satisfied to live as such in the capital city.

“I’m counting on you today too, Mr. Baru!”
“Sure, I’d be glad to.”

Be it the receptionist working at the guild or the people on the streets, they were all endeared by his friendliness and helpfulness, but they did not know—that he was in fact one of the “Eight Glories”, the one with the greatest strength, Bartholomeus.

“Shall we go then, Lord Baru.”

With the elf beauty who only trust in him as his follower, his is truly the War-God who rules over both politics and warfare.

(Source: KADOKAWA, translated)
synonyms: A Normally Dowdy Man is in Essence the Mightiest War God

title.native: 日常ではさえないただのおっさん、本当は地上最強の戦神
title.romaji: Nichijou de wa Saenai Tada no Ossan, Hontou wa Chijou Saikyou no Senshin

116061.description: Power harassment, sexual harassment, year-end party through... Work manga that solves various problems falling on company employees into avant-garde. Chitose Karasuyama (25), a crow who has been transferred to the HR department of Oma Edling, has a very small voice and a very transcendent pace. Special skill is stacking canned coffee towers when senior employee Jun Futa (28) is speaking. The crows, all of which go above and below, together with Fuda, transform the company into a place where everyone can freely fly.
116061.hashtag: #人事のカラスは手に負えない
synonyms: HR Chitose Karasuyama Is out of my Control

title.native: 人事のカラスは手に負えない
title.romaji: Jinji no Karasu wa Te ni Oenai

116062.description:
It’s time for the Ousei Academy camping trip! Yuuya and his classmates head into the wilderness, where they’ll need to build shelters, find food, and otherwise fend for themselves. Yuuya quickly steals the show (and several of his classmates’ hearts) after saving the day, thanks to his maxed-out survival skills! And back in the other world, the day Yuuya promised to meet Princess Lexia has arrived. But an ambush cuts their reunion short when Luna moves to complete her mission and assassinate the princess! As Yuuya recalls their time training together in the forest—and the bond they forged—will he be able to do what’s necessary to stop her…?

(Source: Yen Press)

Isekai de Cheat Nouryoku Ote ni Shita Ore wa, Genjitsu Sekai o mo Musou Suru

116063.description:
A mysterious door stands open, inviting a boy who’s been brutally bullied all his life to take a courageous step forward into the unknown. On the other side, he finds a hoard of priceless artifacts and a world as filled with magic as it is with monsters. The most shocking revelation, however, is that he can bring whatever he wants back with him when he returns to Earth. It won’t be long before this double life changes him forever...

(Source: Yen Press)

116064.description:
On a cold winter afternoon, Daichi Inui notices his classmate Mizuki Mizuno crying and shaking at her desk. After he offers her a tissue, she profusely apologizes, saying that she gets excessively sweaty and teary-eyed when she is nervous. Noticing that his dry hands have become moisturized by her tears, Daichi begins to wonder if hanging out with Mizuki would enrich both his body and soul.

(Source: MAL Rewrite)
synonyms: My Girlfriend Is Dripping With Passion

116065.description: Ichimatsu Kairo's ex-girlfriend, Kusakabe Hiyori, who disappeared 7 years ago appears before him again one day. As someone who was converted into a devout follower of the Hiyori religion, he became unable to live in reality when she left. Reunited, she divulges to him her unreasonable demand, "Ichimatsu-kun, I want my childbirth recorded so give me your sperm."
synonyms: Comment en finir avec son ex

title.romaji: Oujou Giwa no Imi wo Shire!

116066.description: Famicom Rocky is basically Rocky the movie, but with old NES-era video games. The series stars an ineloquent brute of a protagonist who has long, extensive training montages so that he can dramatically compete against vaguely imposing rivals who, for narrative purposes, are deluded into thinking they're better at video games than him.

116071.description: The romantic comedy manga centers on Kōta Nakamichi, who ever since he was a kid he has had female spirits obsessed with him. Kōta is searching for a job and he has a final interview, but the scantily-clad spirits surrounding him make the interview a total failure. However, his interviewer, the company president Karen Suguri, has a secret of her own.

116074.description:
Due to his father's disappearance, Rhine stepped into the vampires territory in search for his father. Little did he know that the cold and arrogant leader of vampires behaved abnormally to him after one night.
Every single day he worried if he could make it out alive while finding his father, and the secret behind this vampire household, can he escape the vampire's control over him?

116075.description:
Fil was raised in the mountains as the grandchild of humanity’s strongest sage, inheriting his talent for magic, and strong enough to defeat dragons with her bare hands.

However, one day, the great sage summoned Fil to tell him:

“Fil, you’re actually a girl.”

"Really!? By the way, what’s a girl?"

Fil's ignorance of gender and other common sense knowledge worried the great sage. Concerned about her future, he decided to enroll Fil into the Royal Academy. It will be the start of an exciting school life for the innocent strongest girl!

(Source: Piccoma, translated)

Not knowing how to raise his dragon, he turns to the internet. However, his walk with his super rare dragon is a trending topic. What kind of insane turmoil will this bring into his life...? Here comes the long awaited manga adaptation of the super popular novel series!!

116079.description:
In the 14th century, police officer Odoacer Scholz is investigating an incident among the Kire Monks.

(Source: Anime News Network)

116080.description:
1) Karera wo Meguru Subete (彼等をめぐるすべて, All about Their Story)
Fujiwara, a high school student with an excessive predisposition to misfortune, lives at a seaside town with his alcoholic father. One morning, after suffering the violence from his father, he fell into the sea. Fujiwara was saved by the refreshing college student, Oono. Fujiwara falls in love at first sight with the kind and handsome Oono. After that encounter, Fujiwara's world becomes vividly colored for the first time...?

2) Hello, World!
synonyms: The Story of the Love Concerning Them

116083.description:
Playboy Shishidou is seen as an enemy by the thoroughbred honor student Shiba. However, it could be said they were close friends before. When he reached puberty, a desire to submit Shiba grew inside Shishidou, causing their relationship to turn sour.

Since then, they haven't being close at all, but the Shiba who's preached Shishidou about his relationships with women, becomes his partner to let his lust out...?!

title.native: サラブレッドはなびかない

116084.description:
Across the multiverse, the manliest and most handsome evil god in history! The handsome Xie Yan transmigrated and fell into a demoness lair. In order not to be sucked dry, he will travel across heavenly realms, cut down the chosen one, and repel the foreign confederation... This is the story of how he eventually becomes the evil god.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.english: Way To Be The Evil Emperor

8. Lightning Strike
9. A Tale of Seven Cities, Battle of Pell Strait

116089.description:
Becca is shocked when her estranged uncle summons her to his estate—especially when he’s always hated her for being born out of wedlock. When she arrives, she finds her cousin Larissa’s fiancé waiting with an unusual idea:. Since Becca looks so much like her cousin, his plan is to trick everyone into believing that Becca is Larissa to win back the family fortune that Larissa has promised to her lover. Before she even has a chance to think, Becca begins her fake life as Leo’s replacement fiancée… Will she be able to play the part?

(Source: Harlequin)

title.native: 身代わりのフィアンセ

116090.description:
Universal Century 0089. Mashiro Oaks as a high school student on Side 2 Colony "Olympus." He gets the high score on a game titled "Walpurgis Night" and, by distributing the video on an underground network, he gets noticed. The tagline reads, "Young Man, defy your cursed fate!!"

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: 機動戦士ガンダム ヴァルプルギス

116091.description:
Fantasy adventuring comedy with a dark elf cleric who invested too much on her insulting skills and her companion, the swordsman who has to put up with her antics.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Nominated for the Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Web Manga Category.

title.native: このヒーラー、めんどくさい

synonyms: There Are a Lot of Sinners in the Caves

116093.description:
The world is deep and wide place. In order to know more about it, the Sky State Central dispatched the investigators Yoki and Shuka to conduct investigations around, and they do so while being very passionate and loyal about their work. This is a story of Yoki who wants to know more about the world and Shuka who loves the world. A slightly mysterious story weaved by these two people traveling around the world, meeting people, and sometimes even solving mysteries. "It sounds like it's going to be an amazing story, isn't it, Yoki?"

"I wonder about that. I don't mind as long as Shuka-senpai is working seriously."

Uranus was a great warrior belonging to the Hero’s party which saved the world. Three hundred years later, he was reincarnated as Agil, the son of a local lord—all while keeping his past level and stats. A proud warrior in his past life, he decides to fulfil his parent’s expectations of becoming a court magician and enrols into the Hero Academy. With his overwhelming stats, he easily passes the difficult entrance ceremony and successfully enrols into the academy. There, he found that his roommate, Shanon was actually a girl disguised as a boy. Furthermore, she was in fact his past comrade, Luka the Hero—!?

116104.description: Day after day, Tokiwagi Towa spends all of his time toiling at his part-time job. His life was far from fulfilling. One day, by a strange coincidence, he gets involved with Wakamiya Rin, a beauty who was the most popular girl in his school. They weren’t supposed to have anything to do with each other. Masato, once bitter and alone, used to spend his time wreaking havoc on other people’s happy relationships. But now he’s too busy being a homemaker with his roommate-turned-lover, Asahi. Unfortunately, their secret relationship seems to have secrets of its own, and Masato just might find himself missing the predictability of single life.

Masato and Asahi went from odd-couple roommates to live-in lovers and are now enjoying their honeymoon phase to its fullest. But Masato can’t help but feel frustrated that he’s unable to share with his family and friends that Asahi is his special someone. And Asahi isn’t helping matters by acting so suspiciously! Just where is he sneaking off to?!

(Source: SuBLime)

Dejected and alone, he’s evading all the happy couples celebrating the festive season when he suddenly bumps into Shinohara Mayu, a beautiful girl in a Santa outfit. When Akane is asked to get rid of evil spirits in a village she stops by, she and her companions find an unconscious young man in an abandoned mine where evil youma lurk. His legs have been chopped off and he lacks the orb that identifies him as a human being. One of her companions realizes the truth—this young man is the abandoned prince of the country of Sai. To the surprise of her companions, Akane makes the decision to take the man with them on their journey—where they await youma unlike anything they've ever seen.

116132.description:
A "kamuro" is a young girl who takes care of and runs various errands for a courtesan, and at the same time studies the art for herself. The way kamuro would refer to their respective courtesans as "big sister" gave rise to the word "oiran", the most elite courtesans in Edo-era Japan. This story takes place in a brothel called Shinkiro in notorious Yoshiwara red-light district, starring an oiran known to many as the "Courtesan from Hell", a super popular sadist specialist named Hashidate. Her personal kamuro, Namiji, narrates the story, and paints a picture of Hashidate that most would never expect. A variety of customers, including townsfolk, samurai, and high-rollers, are in full force as Namiji recounts these fantastic tales!

(Source: Media Do International/Jitsugyo no Nihon Sha)

116133.description:
Angela is mortified when her cringey fanfic about the dethroned Prince Rayburn is published behind her back and becomes a wildly popular bestseller. Not only is it super embarrassing, but the book gets her in trouble with the current imperial family, who now want her head for treason! Luckily, Rayburn's sister Hoya offers to protect her-- but in exchange, she must write a sequel that will improve Rayburn's tarnished reputation. But that's easier said than done, when the scary prince already hates her for writing the first novel. Will Angela be able to chip away at Rayburn's cold exterior and gather enough inspiration for her next book?

(Source: TappyToon)

116136.description:
Ichiro Tadano, a white collar worker, walks through the streets of Japan, trying to use his money he just got from pay day. He runs into a cute girl that's trying to promote a phone game, which he happily downloads. Only, it wasn't a normal game. The phone absorbs him, and he finds himself waking up in a brothel as the richest man in the world with three beautiful women. Did they mention they were virgins?

116139.description:
The demi-humans living in the magical country are threatened everyday. Lately there has been a mysterious hunter appearing in several places.
Appearing as swift as the wind whenever incidents involving demi-humans come up it seems like he is... proposing to the monster girls in the center of these incidents.
What are you even saying?... is what you might think, but it can't helped..
The hunter is turning all kinds of girls into his bride including but not limited to: A rough but cute orc girl, a silent unicorn girl, a mysterious jellyfish girl and a really cool dragon.
The truth is, he is the youngest prince of the magical country and he's into monster girls. To bring peace to this country he has to marry all monster girls - that is the mission he has been given by the king.
I see, i guess i'll have to create my own harem then, huh... Can't be helped!
A fantasy harem story full of love for monster girls!

1. Shiawase no Hana
Takes place after the Drum House arc and centers around Tanjiro, Zenitsu, and Inosuke bonding while attending a village wedding.
2. Dare ga Tame ni
Takes place after the Natagumo Mountain arc during a "date" between Zenitsu and Nezuko. Zenitsu begins to reminisce about his past encounter with a woman named Sayuri.
3. Uranai Sōdō Tenmatsuki
Takes place after the Infinity Train arc. Shinobu attempts to cheer the Kamaboko trio up by sending them to buy sweets. On the way back to the Butterfly Mansion, the trio encounter a fortune teller.
4. Aoi to Kanao
Shinobu sends Kanao to accompany Aoi on a trip to the apothecary.
5. Chūkōikan ☆ Kimetsu Gakuen Monokatari
Modern-day school alternate universe where Zenitsu has had enough of the Morals Committee and begs his friends to help him quit the club. A seemingly easy task becomes complicated when all of the teachers turn out to be unreliable.

The second light novel written by Aya Yajima for Kimetsu no Yaiba containing six stories.

1. Katahane no Chō
The story of how the Kouchou sisters ended up becoming Demon Slayers.
2. Tadashii Onsen no Susume
Uzui motivates Zenitsu to complete his training by offering him the chance to join a mixed-gender bath. Excited, Zenitsu agrees, roping in Inosuke to help him finish the task.

Mitsuri begins to feel troubled after learning about the reason why Shinobu joined the Demon Slayer Corps. Feeling selfish, she begins to avoid the other Hashiras. Obanai and Shinobu, not knowing what's wrong, brainstorm ways to cheer her up.

116156.description: An elite soldier, whose nickname is God of Death, is transferred to another unit known as the PaPaRa Army. The PaPaRa Army is infamous for its elite but hilariously crazy members.

116157.description: 200 years after the events of the original Pappara Army, Prince Izuru's kingdom has been usurped by none other than his own little sister Ranje. Having been defeated and currently pursued by Ranje, Izuru unexpectedly makes contact with a rebel army: the Southern Independent Task Force, Pappara Army. Amongst the rebels are three beautiful girls, each with her own insane antics and brutal manner of dishing out damage. Izuru reluctantly joins forces with the Pappara Army, now to retake his throne.

116158.description:
Shouta Kikuzato’s hopes of starting on his school’s prestigious soccer team are derailed when a terrible incident costs him his leg. Now in his first year of high school (again), Kikuzato has resigned himself to never reaching his athletic dreams. But when Chidori, a passing prosthetist, notices Kikuzato’s artificial limb- and speed-as he races through the train station, the specialist proposes a partnership: Chidori will build Kikuzato a brand-new leg designed solely for speed. All Kikuzato has to do is run!

(Source: Yen Press)

116159.description:
Zhang Gong is a little apprentice pharmacist from Mount Shu. One day he entered the mountain to gather herbs and met an Immortal Hero who was slaying a demon. He accidentally got involved in a demonic battle. After going through a soul-stirring adventure, he finds out about his hidden background, and thus becomes embroiled in the strife of the Three Realms.

(Source: MangaToon)

116161.description:
The story takes place in a barren frontier where people trade goods with each other in order to help each other survive. The Kotobuki Squadron are bodyguards for hire, led by a strict but beautiful squadron leader, an unreliable commanding officer, and a true artisan of a crew chief. Alongside pilots who do not lack for personality, they take to the air in dogfights, letting the engine noise of their Hayabusa fighters ring out in the skies.

(Source: Anime News Network)

116163.description: In this business, you have to become a demon in order to survive. Even better if you side with a demon that can give you the power to make it to the top.

116165.description:
In our infinite universe, there are countless planets and worlds. Among those shining stars, there exists a world called "The Roc Kun". The continent of wind is a land of wars and disorders.

Here, a story of a warrior, is about to begin...

(Source: MangaToon)

116166.description:
In the region of Kalos, an old tale spoke of two legendary Pokemon, Xerneas and Yveltal, who were said to appear every 1000 years to clash with each other. The myth became a reality when the two showed up inVaniville Town one day, wrecking havoc to everything in the area.

With their homes destroyed, X, a prodigy in battling who went into seclusion after an incident related to to the paparazzi, was forced to go on a journey with his childhood friends: Y, a Sky Trainer in training; Trevor the scholar-to-be; Tierno the dancing expert; and Shauna, who aspired to become a Furfrou Stylist. Under the constant threat of the ominous Team Flare, who was after X's mysterious Mega Ring, the five young trainers must stick together and depend on each other to weather through each challege and seek what they find, including an answer to the mystery of Mega Evolution...

title.native: ポケットモンスターSPECIAL X・Y

116167.description:
Ding Yi, an ordinary delivery guy, saved a beautiful, wounded woman assassin from coma on his way home. How can Ding Yi survive around this elusive and indifferent killer? As the wheel of destiny turns, comes an adventurous and exciting world of assassination.

(Source: MangaToon)

116168.description:
The Tale of Zi Wei is a series of comics based on an oriental fantasy novel written by Feng Ge. The comics chronicle the lives of a young wizard, Fang Fei and his friends, all of whom are Taoists at the World of Zi Wei. The main story arc concerns Fang Fei's struggle against a dark and evil Taoists organization.

(Source: MangaToon)

116169.description:
The intertwined three spaces, the dangerous school campus, the blood-shed battlefields. From now on, from then on, even if you revived in this world, what could you change? What would you want to change? Countless monsters in the dark street when night falls and many lives have been devoured by inhuman creatures. How will he retrieve the situation and reverse everything to the beginning?

(Source: MangaToon)

116170.description:
A chance encounter. A handsome soldier. A beautiful woman. A tentative love affair smolders on the snowy cobblestone streets, out of sight of those that might keep them apart.

Veil is a beautifully illustrated full-color romance manga, told in stylish short vignettes, beautiful illustrations, and secret moments.

(Source: Udon Entertainment, edited)

116171.description:
Super sweet and super-sand sculptured female statue against the harem! I often hear: "Three princes and three princesses! Your puppets are fighting again!" The overbearing female CEO traversed to the world of female honors and woke up with seven husbands.

(Source: Chinese Publisher, translated)

116174.description:
By coincidence, Ye Fan became the Yama of the hell and gained a mysterious and scalable underground system. And when everything is going well, he suddenly found that it seems that the underground system is still hiding a secret...

(Source: MangaToon)
synonyms: I Opened The Gates Of Hell

116175.description:
When Fang Lin bought a new smart phone, he found out the phone app gave him a special social network with the immortals. In a dog eat dog world, Lin is taking a stairway to heaven with this special social network.

(Source: MangaToon)

title.romaji: Wo De V Xin Shi Waigua

116176.description:
She's the young, genius scholar of love. The goddess who scientizes love and can solve all of your love problems. To all the men out there not popular enough, not bright enough or who don't have the chance to meet women - Don't give up! For all those little lambs out there lost in love, introducing the ultimate love counseling comic!

(Source: Media Do International/Jitsugyo no Nihon Sha)

title.native: イヴ 恋を科学する麗しき女神
title.romaji: Eve: Koi wo Kagaku suru Uruwashiki Megami

116177.description: Having become an item, Takase and Komai explore the intricacies of a loving relationship, and how they build themselves into stronger people with each other's support.

title.native: ちっちゃい彼女先輩が可愛すぎる。

116178.description: Omega Kiyo is a pole dancer working in a club dedicated to alpha customers. Kiyo's dream is to be his childhood friend, Chii-chan's bride. But Chii-chan thinks of Kiyo like he is his little brother?? Kiyo, a tall and built omega with a complex and Chii-chan, a firm and reliable, shorter alpha, need to find their happy ending!

116179.description: Ji Xianfeng and Zhao Yushuang both have a quirk that transforms them into the opposite sex when exposed to moonlight. One fateful night, they stumbled upon each other’s secret, which led to their lives becoming intertwined and a series of comedic events. A youthful schoolyard romantic comedy thus unfolds!

title.romaji: Yue Yu Er Fen Zhi Yi Lianren

116180.description:
Shindou Eroko is a 27-year-old NEET who’s made a popular persona for herself as a horny, big-breasted woman online. When her glasses are on, she’s in business mode. But the moment her glasses come off? It’s lewd Eroko-san. Unfortunately for her, she’s totally out of cash. Taking a job as a handyman, she immediately finds trouble in the form of high schooler, Hoshi-kun. He’s totally her type, and as of right now, her glasses have just fallen off...

(Source: Comikey)

Note: Takes place after volume 14 of Henjo: Hen na Joshi Kousei Amaguri Senko.

title.native: 進撃のえろ子さん～変なお姉さんは男子高生と仲良くなりたい～
title.romaji: Shingeki no Eroko-san: Hen na Oneesan wa Danshikousei to Nakayoku Naritai

116183.description: Morals Committee Members, Drama Club, Photography Club, and boobs of all sizes - a full lineup of all kinds of cute kouhais! They'll laugh, tease, and even seduce their believed senpais! And they won't hold back to ask, "Aren't I cute?"
synonyms: Just Flirting With a Cute, Annoying Kouhai

title.native: ウザ可愛い後輩とイチャイチャするだけのアンソロジーコミック
title.romaji: Uza Kawaii Kouhai to Ichaicha suru dake no Anthology Comic

116184.description:
Okuman Chouja no Tsumetai Yuuwaku (億万長者の冷たい誘惑, The Italian's Ruthless Seduction)
Her stepbrother may not be as compassionate as he seems. Bella is thinking of running away from her stressful life as an actress when she suddenly remembers Sergio, her stepbrother. Though it may seem odd, he was her first love. After all, they aren't biologically related and he is dashingly handsome! Perhaps she can rely on him... Sergio, however, is bewildered by her phone call. He's done his best to avoid her ever since the day his desire for her first awoke! Still, now that he has become a powerful billionaire, maybe it isn't a bad idea to play a new game. What will happen to innocent Bella when she walks into Sergio's trap?

Hisho wa Himitsu no Koibito (秘書は秘密の恋人, The Billionaire's Ruthless Affair)
Harriet's a logical planner—it's what she does—but can she plan for love? Harriet wants to get married and have kids someday, so she decides to make a checklist for an ideal husband. For instance, he can't be too handsome or too ugly, nor can he be too rich or too poor. Her boss, Alex, is dumbfounded when he hears this. Who would she want to marry such a boring man? It's no wonder Harriet broke up with her fiancé. Despite being born into a poor family, Alex has become a successful real-estate developer. He more than checks off Harriet's list, but she'd be an idiot to fall for a sworn bachelor like him. So what will she do when he asks her to spend a passionate weekend with him at a five-star hotel?

Okuman Chouja to Kawareta Reijou (億万長者と買われた令嬢, The Playboy's Ruthless Pursuit)
Why would I need a thing like eternal love? "There is no eternal love, simply pleasure for one night." Alice works for a women's shelter, and is running a charity auction to raise money when she meets infamous and rich playboy Jeremy. Alice is a 25-year-old virgin, but has trust issues for very good reason. According to rumors, Jeremy is the worst kind of man: charming for one night, then gone the next day. Alice must run from the whispered temptation of one night of pleasure...

(Source: Harlequin/SB Creative Corp.)

116185.description:
June, an oriental girl in a foreign country, becomes the queen's dress-up doll to make a living! June wants to escape once she earns enough money, but she gets caught up in a bigger conspiracy struggle for power.

(Source: WebComics)

Note: Chapter count includes 2 bonus chapters.

116186.description:
Reiji’s life is as miserable as the small town he can’t escape. The most interesting thing that’s ever happened there is a double suicide down by the river. Does Reiji have any power over his fate, or will he too fall into the abyss?

(Source: VIZ Media)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.
synonyms: ห้วงเหวลึกของเด็กหนุ่ม

116187.description:
Born ever so gracefully, but destined to be a disgrace.

The Grand Duchess Evelyn Ra Royceite of the house Royceite was promised to a graceful life from her birth. And yet Her dark-colored hair and eyes made her repulsive by the people of the Theian Empire since they were considered as an ominous sign. Despite all that, her family makes her attend the debutante hosted by the emperor to change her misfortune. On that day, Evelyn meets the grand duchess of Ansian of house Casablanca, the heir to her rival house Casablanca and by far the most beautiful girl that Evelyn has ever seen. Witnessing the hostility and discomfort at the debutante, Evelyn decides to put an end to her miserable life as a caged crow in the house of noble and pursuit her long lost dream of living the wanderlust life as a hired sword. After a few years later, an unexpected person visits at her doorstep.

(Source: POCKETCOMICS)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

116188.description:
The almost invincible teenager, Mu Lian, is actually a country boy who hails from the southern edges. The mysterious city girl, Linglong, has the passion to challenge everything. The two of them are confronted by an evil plot that enshrouds the haunted metropolis. Can they care for each other? Can they save each other? Something extraordinary is happening in the haunted metropolis...

(Source: WeComics)

116189.description:
Tsubame, a high-schooler who possess an extraordinary sense of pitch, had become fearful of singing, something she once loved to do, due to her childhood trauma. However, on one evening, she came across DJ Yuma, who aims to be a composer, and upon sensing her hidden talent, he demands that she sings his song. DJ Yuma forms a band with his best friend Shiori, who aims to be a filmmaker. "'For some reason, his music makes me feels at ease" Yuma and Shiori, the two bishounen, gave Tsubame the courage to sing again.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: つばめと海とドルチェ

116190.description:
Luck that gets replaced with a kiss? Mirika Tamao has been super lucky from the moment she was born. And when she kissed the 'Not-so-lucky' handsome Ichinose, her luck got replaced?! A destined love that starts with a kiss.

(Source: Ikemen Guys)

Included one-shot:
Volume 2: Renai Hensachi 35

title.native: 魔法☆中年 おじまじょ5

116192.description:
Yuta Hibiki awakens with amnesia and the ability see things that others cannot. He first encounters a Gridman in the reflection of his friend Rikka Takarada's computer and it tells him to "Remember his calling," but Yuta doesn't understand what this means. Later, in the distance, he sees an extremely large monster but it doesn't move. It's only when Yuta gets to school that the two sightings make sense: a monster attacks and the hero Yuta saw in the computer screen pulls him within the computer and transforms Yuta into a giant hero named Gridman.

(Source: Anime News Network)

116193.description: Yasuda Ippei is the heir to the wealthy Yasuda Family, and a bright and talented student who is admired by all. On his 18th birthday, he is sent on a year-long journey in which he is guaranteed complete and utter freedom. However, unless he returns by the end of the year with a bride the entire family approves of, he will be disinherited.

116194.description: Based on the life story of the swordsman Miyamoto Musashi.

116197.description:
A recluse becoming Queen?! In a contest for the throne with scions of noble families, I'll do everything in my power to avoid getting embroiled in it!

In the Kingdom of Lindtor, renowned for being governed by a wise ruler, I, Francesca, am the King's granddaughter—a homebody who delights in chess and staying indoors. However, in the wake of my grandfather's sudden demise, it's revealed that he nominated me in his will as a Queen candidate.

While I was stricken with panic, several young noblemen competing to become sovereign appeared before me: the radiant yet overbearing Stewart, the highly intelligent Cyan, and the captain of the knights, Irwine. "Please choose the King from amongst them!" I struggle hard against it, but my efforts are futile. Furthermore, "I pledge my allegiance to you, my Queen." Is that supposed to be an oath, or a marriage proposal?

I'll get back my peaceful and tranquil days!

What will result from this shut-in princess's desperate resistance?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 女王陛下と呼ばないで

116198.description:
Hiyumi is an ordinary teenage girl who, when her father told her they were going to move to Nagano prefecture, immediately pictured life in one of the biggest, liveliest centers of Japan.

She never expected for them to move to one of the least populated towns in the area. A town which takes a mile-long walk to get to a single convenience store. A town where you can count the different families on one hand. That type of town.

Anyway, let’s watch Hiyumi experience her new life in the boonies.

title.native: キサラギくんはドレス探偵

116200.description:
As Joan of Arc is about to be burned at the stake, she confesses to God that she is sick of people and the atrocities she has seen, and wants to die. Unwilling to let that happen, God sends her to modern-day Japan, giving her three years to make up for the time she lost to her holy mission.

(Source: Japanese Publisher, translated)

116201.description: The previous life was a peerless genius in the world of immortality. He was killed by 3 celestial beings. He was accidentally reborn to his 20s by the book of heaven. All he wanted to do was to become an immortal and return to the immortal world, and he became the strongest man on the earth, turning his hands into clouds and covering his hands with rain, provoking anyone who defies him! He is the venerable one! The ruler of 3000 worlds! the guy who is 10 000 times better than Thanos! He is Taixuan Taizun! The Great Immortal!

116202.description:
Tsuzuki Hikari is the only daughter of the Kumicho of the Tsuzuki Group. For 6 years, she harbored an unrequited love for Fuwa Akito, the Waka-gashira – the second in command of the Tsuzuki Group. "I will confess this year!"

A love story that transcends social status and age differences between the tsundere yakuza heiress and the loyal, calm and collected Waka-gashira begins here!

(Source: Bunkasha, translated)

Contains the side story "Hikari to Fuwa no Miru Yume wa" (陽花里と不破の見る夢は).
synonyms: The Young Lady and the Yakuza: the Waka-gashira’s Affection is Sweet but Fierce

title.native: お嬢とヤクザ 若頭の愛撫は甘いが猛々しい
title.romaji: Ojou to Yakuza: Wakagashira no Aibu wa Amai ga Takedakeshii

116203.description:
The Cosmic Era. Coordinators, born through genetic modification and Naturals, who are born naturally. Both experienced two great wars. People devoted themselves to fighting for things they believed in and things they should protect. Fighting gives birth to hatred and hatred in turn gives birth to sorrow. The battlefield swallows the fate of the soldiers and turned into the gravestone to an invisible future.

Although a transient piece arrived in the end, the scars of war run deep. Yet in such a world, there were those who walked a path they strongly believed. Engineers giving their lives and roles to that which was discarded and destroyed: Junkers. Those who fight for those without power: Mercenaries. Those who convey the truth to the people: Journalists. Even if they deviate from the noble path, they will follow a path they believe in according to their own beliefs... Astray.
synonyms: Mobile Suit Gundam Seed Astray: Princess of the Sky

title.native: 機動戦士ガンダムSEED ASTRAY 天空の皇女
title.romaji: Kidou Senshi Gundam Seed Astray: Tenkuu no Princess

116205.description:
Kashima Lin comes from a family of people who can cause dolls to come to life and perform tasks. While she was away from Japan, both her older sister Shiori and her grandfather died in a mysterious fire. She returns to Japan, convinced that Shiori's fiance, the famous violinist Serikawa Akito, murdered them and stole their family's special dolls.

Now Lin, with the help of her childhood friend Tomoe, is determined to do whatever it takes to make her sister and grandfather's murderer pay and to take back what is rightfully hers.

(Source: MangaHelpers)

The manga is incomplete due to the author's passing.

116206.description: One day, a girl appeared out of nowhere claiming to be an exorcist and turning Liu Yanhui’s regular school life upside down. Ever since his troubles began to continuously plague him, his parents were critically injured by demons and even his childhood rival became an exorcist's target. Eventually, the city he has been living in is at risk due to his presence there… How will a young man with a demonic parasite growing in him survive this world?

title.native: NTR 寝取られ百合アンソロジー

116209.description:
A collection of stories:

1. Juusha no Kyuujitsu
2. Kusushi no Shironeko
3. Toaru Idol no Gakuyaura
4. Niwa no Kobanashi

title.native: お姉ちゃん病棟♥ ～弟の×××治療しちゃうよ♥～
title.romaji: Oneechan Byoutou♥: Otouto no xxx Chiryou Shichau yo♥

116212.description:
The story centers on Tatsumi Oomori, a God Eater, as a main protagonist along with the former 2nd Unit leader, Marco Donath, on their quest to annihilate all Aragami.

(Source: God Eater Wiki, edited)

116215.description: Centered around around a feminine-looking young man called Boy, who works as an undercover investigator for the police. His work usually requires him to disguise as a woman.

116216.description: When Urabe Takuma is caught in a incident with a monster, Anunga, the battle goddess saves him.

116217.description:
"Loser" Run Dong suddenly turns into a handsome young lad. He unveils the truth about a new species of "Green Men" invading his school. Though he is gradually mutating, determinations are made to protect his own family, friends and most of all, his beloved girl.

(Source: WebNovel)

116218.description:
The Shinsengumi, a group of bloodthirsty wolves, now howls in China! At the beginning of the 20th century, Sanosuke Harada, a former member of the Shinsengumi, re-appears in Manchuria, northeastern China, where there is still a great deal of unrest. Caught up in a battle between bandits, Sanosuke attracts the attention of one of the most vicious men in China, Zhang Zuolin. In an era where strength is determined by the gun, his weapons of choice are spear and sword. The start of dynamic historical drama about a man who keeps on fighting!

(Source: Comic Days, translated)

116219.description: New York in the 1970s. Trevor Edwards is a successful lawyer who just recently broke things off with his fiancée. One night, Trevor realizes that he lost important documents pertaining to a client, and he can't find them anywhere. Just as he's ready to accept defeat and the end of his career, salvation arrives in the form of Gene—a young cleaner who works in the same building as Trevor's lawyer firm—who saw him drop the papers on his way out. After returning them, Trevor discovers that Gene is homeless and invites him to stay at his house to escape the cold winter night. But is that enough to repay the man who saved him?

title.native: 特例コンプライアンス

116221.description:
What's Remy gonna do, now that the two most popular girls at school are obsessing over him?!

(Source: Toomics)

116223.description: The short story collection released by Akatsuki Natsume after volume 17 featuring a set of eight brand new short stories.
synonyms: Kono Subarashii Sekai ni Shukufuku wo! Detour!
Konosuba: God's Blessing on This Wonderful World! Detour!
God's Blessing on This Wonderful World! Detour!
ขอให้โชคดีมีชัยในโลกแฟนตาซี! แวะข้างทาง!
為美好的世界獻上祝福！ 繞道而行！

title.native: この素晴らしい世界に祝福を！ よりみち！
title.romaji: Kono Subarashii Sekai ni Shukufuku wo! Yorimichi!

116227.description:
Gem Makina, a senior student in the light of the day, is actually an illegal maker of love potions when hid under the veil of obscurity. One day, she discovers an unnamed book in the forbidden section of the library. As Gem experiments with a recipe for a "genuine" love potion, it turns out that what she created was not a love potion, but a fairy of love!

"The love potion is an interconnected string of chains in the galaxy, people always tend to have a suitable match for themselves."

A year later, Gem Makina, who has become a well known matchmaker and pharmacist in the royal palace, is commissioned by the King of Eurare to find a suitable match for the youngest prince, Capere. But there's a big problem with this handsome man. It's even more serious than being weak, fickle, and cheap...

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.
synonyms: 病弱王子的魔法小红娘

116228.description:
At last, the genius mathematician, Dr. Eli, has been found! ...but he has horns?! The journalist Hidemi would do anything to get an interview with the reclusive doctor. However, Dr. Eli seems intent on protecting his secrets…

(Source: Manga.Club)

Contains:
1-4. Nigeta Hitsuji no Tsukamaekata (逃げたヒツジの捕まえ方); Vol. 30, 31, 33, 35 (2013/6, 8, 12, 2014/4)
5. My Name; kakioroshi
6. Kirakira no Kimi (キラキラのキミ); Vol. 23 (2012/4)
7. Tenkousei no Tsunoi-kun ni wa Kaku ga Haeteiru (転校生のツノイ君には角が生えている); Vol.2 (2010/5)
8. Nil no Mizuumi (ニルの湖); Vol.15 (2011/6)

title.english: How to Catch a Runaway Sheep
title.native: 逃げたヒツジの捕まえ方

116229.description:
The optimistic actress Lu Yang, who broke up for her dream. In order not to make her sacrifice in vain, she worked hard towards her dream but to no avail. The genius actor, Chi Cheng, who was also struggling towards his dream, was more isolated after falling out of love… The two have become frenemies from enemies because of the same encounter. They encouraged and supported each other on the road of acting. Could they listen to their hearts and believed in love again?

(Source: Webcomics)
synonyms: The Innocent Heart of a Child

title.english: What Love Looks Like: Heart Wants What It Wants
title.romaji: Aiqing De Yangzi: Xin Zhi Suo Xiang

116230.description: A mysterious triangular relationship between Hasami Youichi, who has a secret love for Miss Ghost (Yuurei-san), and the public morals chairperson Kagesaki Kisara, who has a secret herself.

116231.description:
Helen loved her husband, Dan, from the bottom of her heart. The teenage sweethearts tied the knot two years ago, and their life together was wonderful. Until the day Helen came home from work early with a nasty cold…and found her half-naked husband with his secretary, Celine. When she wasn’t home, it seems the two of them had been… She couldn’t even think about it! Dan begged her to trust him. But what on earth was she supposed to believe!

(Source: Harlequin)

116239.description:
Yang Cheng, a loser who got cheated on by his girlfriend, drank far too much and got lost in the woods where he was bit by a zombie and turned into a zombie with super power himself! After then he became a pretty, Ye Xuanlin’s bodyguard and found out that she was in great danger! Will he protect her? What should he do now?

(Source: MangaToon)

title.native: 美女大小姐的僵尸高手

116240.description:
I like love comedies.

Still, in reality there is no such thing as love comedy developments... or so i thought when all of a sudden a beautiful girl came out of nowhere?!

Furthermore, she says: [Seems like a certain person's wish has become reality!] ?!
synonyms: Kono Ato Mechakucha Love Comedy Shita
Kono Ato Mechakucha Love Come Shita

title.native: このあと滅茶苦茶ラブコメした
title.romaji: Kono Ato Mechakucha Love Kome Shita

116241.description:
Zhou Wei Qing, who was born in the Heavenly Bow Empire without a Power Jewel or Elemental Jewel, was treated as a joke. He is the son of the empire's Admiral Zhou who is a Nine Jeweled Heavenly Jewel Master.
An opportunity arose when he swallowed the Dark Demon Tiger God's Life Bead from another world. From then on, he embarked on a road of adventure, finding true love and finally becoming a Twelve Jeweled Heavenly Jewel Master!
synonyms: ドラ息子は最強天珠師

116243.description: The daily life of a cute grandma and her cute cat.

116244.description: The dog trainer Yui was summoned into another world as a "Guiding Hand" to raise a baby dragon. The dragon is a "Holy Dragon", who have protected the humans from the invading demons for many generations

title.native: 赤ちゃん竜のお世話係に任命されました
title.romaji: Akachan Ryuu no Osewagakari ni Ninmei saremashita

116245.description: The daily lives of two cats and their dog friend.

116253.description: What is beyond the farthest horizon? The final sea. Death... Hope...Freedom... The girl who carried the furthest secret by birth. For the girl... dreaming and living freely was not allowed. A word like freedom was nothing but longing. She was made to live in a closed and narrow world. Even dying and living were chosen by someone. So I thought. If it's that we were given only poor scenarios from God, I want to share death with you, not someone. I want to give half my life to her. Even if it was sharing death. That's why I'll walk with you. Beyond that horizon. We met and shared two lives with one death.
synonyms: For You I Will Kill Everyone: Project Dia Horizon

title.native: 君のために、お姉ちゃんがみんな殺してあげる～プロジェクト ディアホライゾン～
title.romaji: Kimi no Tame ni, Oneechan ga Minna Koroshiteageru: Project Dia Horizon

116254.description: High school student Mikuriya loses his way one day and finds himself in a heteromorphic town. That is, a town that exists between the space of two worlds, a town where after death, souls that have been distorted and transformed reside. Mikuriya ends up working there at a store named Kouzuya.

title.native: ケッコーなお手前です。

116256.description:
First year student Hiyoko looks up to Manabe, who looks like a manga hero she likes. But the real Manabe gets angry easily, has a bad mouth... totally different from a hero. Yet, he would randomly smile. Sometimes, he would be really gentle too?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

Note: Includes the one-shot "in my rain".

title.native: やさしくないキミが好き

116257.description: You're making my heart beat all alone stupid. The unfriendly girl, Reina is a first year in high school. Because of her childhood friend, Kojima Shin, she became the boy's basketball manager. He was like a small brat when they were in elementary school, but now he's gentle and so cool. But there's a Senpai who he looks up to. But I can't seem to stop falling in love with him...!?

116261.description:
Even though it was just one night of passion, my heart longs for you...

Goldie is attacked by robbers but saved by the CEO of Atlas Group, Gael. He even tends to her wounds and says he’ll help her get her first gig as an actress if she attends a party with him. Under his care, she is dressed to the nines and beautiful. But she cannot allow herself to fall for a man who reigns over such a dazzling world. Despite knowing this, Gael’s sweet whispers sway Goldie and she offers him her virginity. But the next morning, he treats her as if she’s a prostitute!

(Source: Harlequin)

116263.description:
In the adversity of life, people are not as good as dogs. Once I opened my powerful eyes, I saw the ugliness as well as the beauty of the world! What is the secret behind the female body in the jade coffin, the mysterious bronze book, the ancient alloy…

(Source: MangaToon)

116264.description:
Kasia Del Roman is a soldier crafted to become an assassin. She lost her human emotions long ago and lived her life as a simple tool, just to be thrown away in her final moments. She couldn’t even die a proper death as she opened her eyes to a battlefield of a different world. Will she live the same life she did in her original world?

(Source: Pocket Comics)
synonyms: 红莲之罪：转生成为女骑士
ชะตาชีวิตลิขิตสีเพลิง

116266.description:
Naoya just got a girlfriend, the gorgeous Saki-chan, and though their intensities often pit them against each other like ice and fire, they're totally, uncontrollably in love with each other. He vows never to cheat...when out of the blue he recieves another confession! Nagisa's cute, sweet, and she's made him lunch to boot! He knows he can't cheat, but he can't let a cutie like this get away...so he does the logical(?) thing: Asks Saki for permission to date them both! The confidence! The arrogance! The very gall! No matter the outcome, Naoya's future will be lively!

(Source: Kodansha USA)
synonyms: จะคนไหนก็แฟนสาว
Kanojo Mo Kanojo - Confissões e Namoradas

116268.description: Does the cat with the bell say meow? Found sick on the side of the road, when they first met he was like a stray cat. Nao and Suzu begin their journey with each other in a way, unlike others. Follow this cute, fluffy story as their life and past slowly combines.
synonyms: Suzu Tsuki Neko wa Nyao to Naku?
Does the Cat with the Bell Say Meow?

title.native: 鈴付きネコはにゃおと鳴く?
title.romaji: Suzutsuki Neko wa Nyao to Naku?

116270.description: Little short stories about a girl and her panda boyfriend.

116271.description: You mustn’t ever look down into the depths of your memories—

116274.description: The one-shot follows a married couple who live in a high-rise apartment complex, and their neighbor who moves in.

116277.description: Part of the special edition to the final volume. Includes one short comic.

116278.description:
Separate 114-page volume bundled with the special edition of the Toaru Kagaku no Railgun manga volume 5. It contains special illustrations, comics and 2 mini-novels. A mini-novel by the author of the Baccano! and Durarara!! series, Narita Ryogho.
Misaka Mikoto finds herself fighting against the Rank 7 Level 5 of Academy City, Sogiita Gunha. However, a young girl turns out to be the culprit behind their unprepared display of abilities: a primary school student named Kihara Nayuta.

(Source: Toaru Wikia)
synonyms: Toaru Jihanki no Fanfare, Toaru Jihanki no Sonzai Shoumei, A Certain Vending Machine's Proof of Existence

116282.description: While taking a break from studying, Neji Renta, an eighteen year old boy, saves a kitten but dies right after. The god told him that he can reincarnate but he chooses to live a life in another world instead. With his new friend kitten, the god's pet named Mii, he will try his best to enjoy his life in the other world as Nero with his power to summon high quality cat food.

116283.description: Six girls were transported to a mysterious location and have to play a game. Maybe if they win they will be able to leave.

116284.description:
Kuji Shousuke’s life changed forever when he was running through an airport trying to get a story for the magazine he writes for and he accidentally wound up stumbling into and kissing a pop star named Cynthia. Everyone was outraged, including Cynthia, but she kissed him back. That’s when things started going strange for Shousuke; he saw people naked instead of clothed, he blacked out, he attacked people without remembering any of it.

Just when it looks like his life is going straight to hell, he meets Yuma, who fairly quickly figures out that something was done to him. Yuma is a psychic, and with her band of followers they try to figure out what was done to Shousuke. And that’s when things get truly strange...

116295.description:
Due to low budget, the school library has no heating installed. Despite that, however, a trio of classmates have to perform their library duties, regardless of how cold that makes the two girls, Tsukami and Iidabashi. Everything appears to get solved, though, when the two discover that Mayumura has a high body temperature. That is, until Mayumura gets a boner, and, embarassed, confesses that he likes them both, after which one thing leads to another, and any complaints about temperature are slowly forgotten.

Note: Published in COMIC AUN 2019-04～2020-10.

One day Sayuoko Takano goes to work and finds that a giant cat has taken the place of her coworker Hishikawa.
This supernatural miniseries by Ako Tanaka and Moto Hagio follows a scrappy young woman and a mysterious bakeneko named Gevara

The manga follows the carefree life and delicate relationship between a nine-year-old brother-in-law and his older brother's 21-year-old wife.

116314.description:
A rendezvous through the glass window between a young president and a window cleaning worker! Hakuhou Tamaki is the young president of Hakuhou Foods, one of the leading enterprises in Japan. He had given up on things called family due to his father’s continued marriages and divorces, and until now thinks that he doesn’t need a romantic relationship in his life. However, the moment he met the eyes of the window cleaners Yashiro Jin over the window, his world completely changed!

“I want to talk to you who smiles on the other side of the beautifully polished glass.”

From that day, Tamaki begins his first-ever romantic approach…!

title.native: 地上100メートルで、逢いましょう

116318.description:
Maro is a beautiful goddess who lives a peaceful life in the heavens and uses her water ladle to control the weather at her command. But she clumsily drops it onto Earth and hurries to retrieve it only to find that it was picked up by possibly the worst person it could have been. Kiriko Toshiki seems to be a great kid who is kind to everyone, smart, athletic and good looking, but that is all a façade and underneath it all is a sadistic elementary school kid. When he finds the water ladle, his life changes. With the water ladle in his possession, he now controls the weather and Maro is left helpless until she gets it back from Kiriko. But until that day comes, Kiriko plans on teasing and torturing Maro in so many ways.

Note: Includes 3 extra chapters.

116321.description:
Princess Alicia doesn't want to be married off in an arranged marriage, so she agrees to an impossible wager with her mother: Enter an all-boys school as a "boy" and find real love among a number of approved candidates. What she doesn't plan on is falling in love with handsome Lucius, a non-approved guy who figures out her secret! Oh, and she realizes she's a reincarnation of a romance-novel-loving girl who is living in one of her favorite stories! Find out what happens next in this comical love fantasy!

(Source: Renta!)

116331.description: A cohabitation comedy between a loner JK and a stalking reaper! All alone in the world, Amamiya Chifuku found herself being haunted by a (self-proclaimed) handsome death reaper. Soon she met others also possessed by various gods and spirits. It's a lively but dark (love) comedy!
synonyms: 被死神附身的天宮同學

116333.description:
Yui Mitsuya and Masugu Tateishi aren't just any coworkers-they totally have the hots for each other. His helpful yet humble attitude makes her giddy, and her cuteness leaves him grinning like a fool. Problem is, they're trying to keep their new relationship under wraps to avoid making things awkward at work. But seeing how they can't keep their hands off each other, they run the risk of spilling their little secret with each passing day at the office.

(Source: Kodansha USA)

The strongest soldier and a band of ferocious heroes -- fighting for their country, fighting for their people! Only death can stop them, and they will press on until their dying breaths!

(Source: Qidian)

116337.description: A young wealthy businessman was suddenly kidnapped by a dark organization that he refused to work with. He was used as an experimental subject of developing new chip-based technology that gives the subject extra-ordinary abilities. Will he be able to escape and take revenge?

116339.description:
A spin-off of Mairimashita! Iruma-kun made in collaboration with the Youtube/Nico Nico Douga group ○○ no Shuyaku wa Wareware da!

The story follows Shaoron, a freshman at Babyls who wants to join the Student Council and become popular.
