116340.description:
At the age of 19, Ayano makes the fateful decision to set foot into the adult film industry. Alienated from her family and feeling she lacks a place in the world, she wields what "assets" she has -- her body -- and finds success in her newfound calling. This is the story, at turns delicately nuanced and starkly graphic, of a "porn star's" journey: everyday struggles, what happens when family finds out, and even love. The novel by a real-life adult-film actress is brought to life in manga form!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.native: 涙の乙女 大西巷一短編集
title.romaji: Namida no Otome: Oonishi Kouichi Tanpenshuu

116342.description:
Yachiyo doesn’t know why exactly Haguchi ended up living with her, but he’s here now, making her tiring daily life a little bit brighter, one delicious meal at a time. Where does Haguchi come from, and is there anything his mysterious blobby self can’t do?

(Source: Manga Planet)

116343.description:
A college freshman, Zhou Xiaoan, accidentally puts on a ring of unknown origin from the Shang Dynasty and spits out a horrible blood zombie from his mouth. A secret in the history of mankind is unveiled…

(Source: WeComics)

116344.description:
Who has not heard of the famous Shinsengumi, the terrible faction of nationalist samurai? But when its four most eminent members are teleported to contemporary Kyoto, nothing goes well... Where has this Japan full of values that they love so much gone to?! At first lost, these famous male warriors will regain their senses. Yet one question remains: will they succeed in turning their country around which is in full decay?! Nothing is sure for certain...

(Source: Manga News, translated)
synonyms: しっぷうじんらい

116345.description:
The story takes place 10 years after Over Rev!. Ryoko returns to Japan while there is a high school girl named Moto who also loves cars. Two people will cross paths and start more car legends!

(Source: Official website, translated)

116346.description: When countless of my classmates were addicted to the super popular game “Battle of the Gods”, I was not tempted. This game is highly realistic, based off of powerful historical generals and mythical figures, where they battle against each other! Your potential determines your fate, the winner becomes the king while those who are defeated, eat dust. Analysis failed….. What’s with this situation? Is it a bug? My profile can’t be matched with a character? In that case, congratulations on triggering the game’s hidden story! I accidentally…... Opened it.....

116348.description:
The future of hungry dad and son rabbit is food heaven! However... the sweetness was too sweet!

A surreal and comedic sweet adventure!

synonyms: To you who smiles through the lens

title.native: レンズ越しに微笑む貴女へ

116351.description:
"The teacher so strict is loving to me"
A man's dreams captured in 24 pages, with a power in his drawing to break the heavens.

Junichi Miyakawa's special. A rookie who won the BG Manga Award.
synonyms: Hiiragi-Sensei is a Failure as a Teacher

116353.description:
As the Demon King, Yifan Zhuo uses his knowledge and power, collected over millennia, to defeat all foes, until the day he is betrayed. With his last breath, the demon king manages to reincarnate... but into the body of a puny young servant! To Yifan's dismay, the servant has a spirit bond with his mistress, Lady Luo. Yifan, now known as Fan, finds himself inexplicably drawn to Lady Luo and links his fate to her family. With Lady Luo at his side, will he regain his place as the Demon King?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: The Servant Is the Demon King?!

116356.description:
Akira's overjoyed to go to the hot springs with his cute girlfriend Rika, even if it means her father is tagging along. But when his youthful hormones get the better of him at night, it isn't his girlfriend who takes notice, but her dad! The older man doesn't hesitate to take advantage of Akira's embarrassed silence, ravaging the boy while his daughter sleeps soundly beside them, and no matter how he tries to resist, Akira is helpless before the pleasure...

(Source: Fakku)

116357.description:
Akira went to his girlfriend's house to help her study with her homework. Only when she mentions her father did Akira react to it like an aphrodisiac. He excuses himself, hoping to dash away from the problem by going to the bathroom, only to run into the father halfway there. Rika is going to be waiting for awhile.

(Source: Fakku)

116358.description:
Akira and Rika head out to enjoy a festival date, but as always Rika's father can't let Akira be. After dirtying the yukata gifted to him by the older man, Akira is given a chance to be forgiven. If he can withstand going on his date with the constant teasing torment of a special gift, that is. Will Akira be able to hold out and enjoy the festival with his girlfriend? Or will her father and his plans prove to be too much for the boy?

(Source: Fakku)

title.english: Secret on the Evening of Fireworks
title.native: はなびのよるのひみつ

116359.description:
We're asking the important questions here: what if French heroine Jeanne d'Arc were a femboy?

(source: J18)

116360.description: Swords and winds cover the sun and the moon, mastering the glory of Immortals. There are six billion people in the world, but I am arrogant. The Emperor of the Immortal World is reborn in the bustling city of lights and wines. Beautiful police, delicate stars, glamorous ladies, exotic princesses... From then on, a former urban loser, turned over completely, and embarked on a peerless road that would make the world feel horrified and provoke the beauty of the world. "The world laughs at me, the world laughs at me, you see, after the ages...
synonyms: Rebirth of The Urban Mad Immortal

116361.description: To defeat his uncle who destroyed his family, the teenager Xuan Tian embarked on a martial arts training journey to hone his sword techniques. From a teenager who knew nothing to a Sword God of his generation, those he once saw as strong are now mere specks of dust to him. With one finger, I obliterate all; With my sword, I defy the heavens! And his path, leads him directly to the limitless heavens!

116363.description: Lin Xiu returned from Xiandao, swaying the masters of each road with a proud attitude. With immense medical knowledge of both the spiritual world and the Physical World. Watch as Lin Xiu solve problems for the everyday life, and the supernatural. What? someone is making trouble? Not satisfied? Are you someone important? Screw you then, i step on people like you just for fun, money? power? what does that gotta do with cleaning out the garbage?
synonyms: Metropolitan City's Ying Yang Miracle Doctor

116365.description:
He was away from home for 3 years... and away from his world for 3,000 years.

3 years ago, he fell into a rift, into a world of immortals, where time flew differently. He struggled 3,000 years there to come home, only to find his family... gone. Now a 3,000-year-old monster, will he slaughter his way to the reunion, or... will he have to start all over again?

(Source: MangaToon)
synonyms: Mortal Life of the Celestial Emperor

title.native: すやすやヒプノセラピー

116367.description:
"To think that once upon a time, I slaughtered immortals, punished demons, and took over the underworld...!"

Gu TianLang was once the infamous emperor of the underworld where he ruled over immortals and demons alike with an iron fist. Keyword here, “was.” When he incurs the wrath of the Heavenly Dao—an ancient ruler who has attained immortality and a demonic higher power—his people turn on him and lay siege to his castle. Surrounded and outnumbered, Gu TianLang gets ruthlessly and publicly stripped of his powers, smote, and dies.

Only, thanks to a mysterious jade, he wakes up 500 years later! Will he be able to exact his revenge on the Heavenly Dao and get his kingdom back?!

(Source: Comikey)

title.native: 荒野のコトブキ飛行隊 荒野千一夜
title.romaji: Kouya no Kotobuki Hikoutai: Kouya Senichiya

116370.description:
Framed to death in his previous life, he is reborn to his high school and happens to witness the resuscitation of fairy and the radical change of the world. Being young again, he restarts cultivation. This time, he'll protect his friends and family, he'll leave no regret, and he'll be the eternal king!

(Source: Webcomics)

116371.description: Yui is a young woman who, as a favour to her sister, goes to a stranger's family to decline a marriage request addressed to her. The latter, too busy, doesn't have time to go there herself... But for Yui, what seemed like a burden turns out to be a real godsend: when she meets Kosuke, the suitor, it's love at first sight... Yui then takes her sister's place and a new love story begins!

116372.description:
Koyomi Inagawa, wedding planner. Despite working freelance, she is highly sought-after and admired for her skill even among her peers in the wedding industry. She tends to embrace every whim of the bride and groom with a sunny warmth, and it is in her nature to be fired up by an impossible challenge. While continuing to build a delicate rapport with Shinoyama - an old colleague and rival from her time working at a big-name hotel back in the day - as she goes, Koyomi spends her time rushing to and fro to make each new day "the best day of your life" for someone out there!!

(Source: Manga Plaza)

116373.description:
The anthology lauded by Toward the Terra's Keiko Takemiya as "A manga much like a pomegranate, that brings forth different flavors the more you chew on it, with a dry first bite and a juicy inside." A world where reality gets entangled with illusion and human emotions get entangled with evil spirits gets brought to life in Fumi Shimomura's pseudo-historic horror stories. Includes six stand-alone short stories - "Hana Gurui", "The Grave of Butterflies", "Neck", "Water God", and the previously unpublished "Revival" and "Demon Dance".

(Source: Manga Planet)

116374.description:
In a small country on the border where the scars of war have yet to heal, Princess Yato, who is called a “shinigami” (a goddess of death), has been married to the feudal lord. A Buddhist image maker named Obito takes one good look at her face and wishes to carve her face on a Buddha statue. A turbulent, passionate story illustrating a man who viciously lived while continuously questioning the meaning of life. In addition to the main story Busshi, you can also read Fumi Shimomura’s “Stories for a Rainy Night”, first time to be published on a volume, and her latest work “Anatta”.

(Source: Manga Planet)

116376.description:
"The chief of the dragon species, born of the first darkness alongside the world's first magic - eleven Imperial dragons opposing man's power of conquest." Weill, whose magician mentor was killed by an imperial dragon, sets off to exact his revenge, but...?

(Source: Manga Planet)

116377.description:
''What do you want me to do, Master?'' The following morning after bringing home an injured dog, I awake to find a man in my room... who claims he's the dog I saved! No matter how you look at him, though, he seems human, and what's worse, he's the exact type of hottie that I'm into!! (Well, except for the ears and tail.) Unsure what else to do, we start living together, and while he is completely unphased by the intimacy of things like showering together, I find my heart racing!

(Source: Renta!)
synonyms: I have begun to keep a inukare

116378.description: A heroine appears in the universe where the cyborgized pirate "Kaiborg" roams! A pirate battle story of "Bone Crusher" and her skeleton hat partner!

116379.description:
A talking sex doll appears in the room of a naive high school girl! It seems that the sex doll that her brother bought came to life and can talk...? It's a little more vulgar than usual, but sometimes it's a little warm and fuzzy. A heartwarming comedy about an adolescent schoolgirl and her sisterly sex doll that transcends the R-rated barrier!

(Source: Tonari no Young Jump, translated)

116380.description:
From his deathbed, all Hero-King Inglis wishes is to live again, for himself this time: a warrior's live he'd devoted himself to before his rise to power.
His patron goddess, Alista, hears his plea and flings his soul into the far future. Not only is Inglis now the daughter of a minor noble family, but at her first coming-of-age ceremony at 6, she's found ineligible to begin her knighthood!
However, for a lady of Inglis's ambition, this is less a setback and more the challenge she was (re)born to overcome. "It's not the blood that runs through your veins that makes a knight; it's the blood you shed on the battlefield!" The curtain rises on the legend of an extraordinary lady squire reborn to master the blade!

(Source: J-Novel Club)
synonyms: The King of Heroes reincarnates to polish his skill to the limit and becomes the strongest knight in training in the world♀
ราชาวีรชน เกิดใหม่เพื่อขัดเกลาวิถีต่อสู้ และ กลายเป็นอัศวินฝึกหัดที่แกร่งสุดในโลก♀

title.romaji: Eiyuu-ou, Bu wo Kiwameru Tame Tenseisu: Soshite, Sekai Saikyou no Minarai Kishi♀

116381.description: The slapstick school life of Shinigami student-candidates!
synonyms: Training School for God of Death

title.native: 死神憑きの天宮さん ―死神養成学校編―
title.romaji: Shinigami Tsuki no Amamiya-san: Shinigami Yousei Gakkou-hen

116382.description:
Aria Roscent mercilessly bullied her stepsister Mielle and paid the ultimate price for her misdeeds—but not before Mielle revealed that she’d manipulated Aria into harassing Mielle in the first place! Instead of dying, Aria is sent back in time and gifted a strange hourglass with mysterious powers. Now, Aria’s just got one goal: to embrace her role of villainess and utterly destroy Mielle’s life!

(Source: Yen Press)
synonyms: La villana retrocede el reloj de arena
悪女は砂時計をひっくり返す
时光沙漏·逆转命运的少女
ย้อนเวลากลับมาร้าย
Aria & Die goldene Sanduhr der Zeit

116383.description: Bai Li Yun Xiao - with a spiritual life in the continent Jiuxiao. After his death he was resurrected, however, he returned 300 years ago, returned to urban adolescence, changed his life, and climbed to the top of the world again. "Whether in heaven or on earth, only I can win"

116385.description:
Some people with abnormal abilities invading the institute have triggered a battle for superpowered organs! Has the unknown creature been resurrected as a teenager? What is the ending of the forbidden love between the decadent bodyguard and the test...

(Source: Wecomics)

116386.description:
A boy named Hao Qi accesses a hacked game account which pulls him into the world of 'A Hero's Journey'. Although he is a part of the game's world now, he retains the unfair advantages granted by the hacking program, allowing him to breeze through this world of magic, monsters, and martial arts. With cherished friends and intrepid companions, he blazes a trail through the lands.

(Source: Webnovel)

116387.description:
It tells the story of Tenka Taihei, a thin little Japanese man, docile but easily manipulable, whose sperm have two flagellums and gives birth to a third human gender: neither male nor female. These “third sex” humans, born inside test tubes and mass-produced, will be used for servile purposes.

(Source: FLBLB Edition, translated)

116388.description: Starting with the tale of a prince on the run from a general intent on taking over the world, followed by the story of Wonder-kun, a boy raised by animals on a deserted island trying to protect his friends and home from a corrupt industrialist.

synonyms: The Tale of a Kind Demon

title.native: 終わる恋じゃねぇだろ

116395.description: A spin-off of Gabriel Dropout that focuses on Tapris.

116401.description:
Takuya and Rika are coworkers in a travel agency in Tokyo. They’re both single, but they don’t mind, since they’re introverts with fulfilling lives at home. Unfortunately, now their job is looking to staff an office in Siberia, and non-married employees are the first to be considered. Rika is desperate to avoid the transfer and goes to Takuya with an idea: if they pretend they’re getting married in a year, they can stay in Tokyo. The only problem is the two of them barely know each other! If these two quiet coworkers “fake” a relationship, will it turn into something real?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

116402.description: Edo's largest recreation area, Yoshiwara. In this town where the feelings of the living and the dead are swirling, Ao, a prodigy prostitute got lost in an unknown shrine. It was a “village of shrines” (Shenchoku Shrine) between Ukiyo (The Floating World aka Yoshiwara) and Sakai (Borderland) that only those who are strongly seeking the benefits of spiritual trials can reach! Only prostitutes who have a beautiful and sad past are visiting the company. In order to guide and save the soul... Along with Yakumaru of Miyaji, Ao will unravel their lives——!

116403.description: Tamaki, a genius Ukiyoe artist and Sharaku daughter, is 15 years old. After her father's death, she was living with her favorite parent Ukiyoe Emoto, the second generation of Koshodo, Shigesaburo Ashiya, drawing her favorite picture. Although Tamaki has a light love for Shigesaburo Ashiya, Koshodo has declined since the second generation can no longer sell pictures. Satoshi Shige who wants to break through the situation orders Tamaki to be held by Yutaro while holding his hand as a coverage of the spring painting...!?
synonyms: Syaraku Shinjyu: Her Shunga Blooms in Edo

116404.description:
Tokyo, the imperial capital of the 14th year of the Taishou era. Amen Oryo, a pickpocket girl who lost her parents in the earthquake, met Haruya Karasuma, a high school student who calls himself an "Onmyouji." At that time, heinous crimes were occurring frequently in the Imperial City, but there are rumors that a "tengu" will definitely appear near the scene...!? An exciting Taishou buddy action!!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title.native: 大正電氣バスターズ 〜不良少女と陰陽師〜

116405.description:
A scandalous romance in another world! The noblewoman Lidiana, daughter of a duke, is actually the reincarnation of a modern Japanese woman who was tossed into this fantasy world. Although she’s engaged to the handsome crown prince, the last thing she wants is to marry into a polygamous royal family. Knowing that only a virgin can marry the prince, she devises a plan to lose her virginity to a mysterious playboy at a masquerade ball. Lidiana lands her masked Lothario, shares an explosive night with him, and goes to confess to the prince so she’ll be set free. The only problem is…the prince himself isthe masked man, and now he wants her more than ever. This sexy romcom is a whole new kind of adventurous fantasy!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

116410.description:
A condensed biography of Kublai Khan, as told by Professor Munakata.

This is the second tie-in to NHK's Road of Civilization special.

116411.description:
Since his father died, manga artist Ichiro has barely scraped by, forced to support his two younger siblings on just a middle school education. He doesn’t even have time to learn how to use a computer, which forces him to keep wrestling with pen and paper. When his art assistants quit to strike out on their own, on top of juggling deadlines, family, and the constant fear of losing his job, Ichiro feels close to a total breakdown. But then a new assistant pops into Ichiro’s life, and his prospects immediately start to brighten! She’s an incredible artist, she always finishes on time, and she’s beautiful, to boot! But she also seems to know an awful lot about him, and soon, she makes a confession that bends Ichiro’s mind beyond the confines of Earth…

(Source: Kodansha USA)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.

116413.description: Set in the Baroque Spanish royal palace, a court painter is set to draw a portrait of His Majesty at the Minister's recommendation. However, while watching the royal art collection, he finds a woman who breaks a picture with a short sword.

title.native: 宮廷画家のうるさい余白〈ブランカ〉

116414.description:
This was Takahashi's first foray into manga for children. It follows MOON, a giant alien rabbit who is trying to get back to his planet. He lands in Japan and gets help from a young boy named Shota. The first few chapters revolve around Shota trying to overcome his fear of heights.

Originally published in magazine Shougaku Sannensei.

116417.description:
Chikako Fujitani, 18 years old, is a first-year student at Hano Women's Junior College. She finally gets to live on her own, enjoying her time with her apartment neighbors, Kanro (a fellow college student aspiring to be a manga artist) and Chiaki (posing as a college student while actually working as a tour guide, on the lookout for potential boyfriends). There's also Iwata, whom she met on a guided tour and had a crush on since junior high, Nagae, and Makoto, the landlord's son... There are plenty of guys who catch her interest.

This is a special love story that realistically portrays the bold, delicate, and clumsy romances of college students.
synonyms: アイドルを探せ―昭和モダンガールズ

116418.description: Chubby and plain, Taeko's biggest worry is whether she'll ever have the courage to tell her crush how she feels. Then one day a mysterious cousin comes to stay and Taeko's world is shattered. Cast out of her own home after her mother's death, Taeko stumbles into the night and is hit by a truck. When she wakes up, she's greeted by a doctor who promises to turn her life around. And thus begins a tale of revenge and intrigue that's a roller coaster of cracked out soap opera fun from start to finish.

116422.description:
"Even if this universe is truly nothing more than a brutal, bloody, dark forest, we Cultivators will burn all that we have just to give off a single weak flickering spark in the darkness!"

"No matter how weak each spark is, how short-lived, how small... As long as the sparks flow unabated, then one day one of those sparks will light some tinder, and that tinder shall light some fallen branches, and those branches shall set ablaze each and every last tree of the forest!"

"In the end, even the smallest sparks will eventually set the dark forest ablaze and illuminate the whole world!"

116423.description:
It’s a story about adventure in the virtual world.
During the investigation of the disappearance case of the South City, police officer Zhang has noticed a girl named Jiang Han. Later the girl was forced to enter a holographic game, in which she found the boy of that disappearance case and other missing people, and started an adventure…

116424.description:
After crossing over to another dimension, a young man from Earth gets help from a system that gives him all kinds of information about everything taking place in his new world.With so much knowledge at his fingertips, he seizes the opportunity to rise to the top! He cultivates incredibly powerful abilities and martial arts techniques that defy heaven itself! He also obtains all sorts of treasures, including miraculous medicinal pills and divine weapons that even the gods would fear! With all of this in his hands, the young man from Earth shall reign supreme!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

116427.description:
Collection of short stories:

1. Daddy and Me
2. Lila and Sion
3. Goodby My Life

5. I'm Not Here

116428.description:
He was once a prince… but 10 years later, he's just a bum!

In high school, Utako was a dull-looking girl with no friends. By chance, she runs into Aoyama, the "prince" who was the most popular guy in class. Back then, Aoyama-kun was not only good-looking, but he was also kind to Utako, despite her outcast status… But that sparkling Aoyama-kun has turned into a scumbag playboy…! A heart-throbbing love story between adults!

(Source: Kiss Comic, translated)

116429.description: A stand-alone story of Boon getting bullied. Is set in a different universe from "Tsunbaka" but has the same main character.

116431.description: The girl, Charlotte, who came to the secret territory, suddenly met a beautiful gentleman and a shrine maiden. However, it seems that these two people have a lot of secrets to tell everyone ...!? If you read the extraordinary article of new reporter Charlotte, you will surely not be thrilled and excited !!! Mysterious UK Romantic, who is the first person to scoop the secret !!?

title.native: 天使がのぞきみ―英国貴族と領民たちのひみつ―
title.romaji: Tenshi ga Nozokimi: Eikoku Kizoku to Ryoumin-tachi no Himitsu

116432.description:
All the Ojamajos are studying to achieve their dreams : Hazuki at a music conservatory in Paris, Aiko at the sports science department of Waseda University, Onpu to be an actress in New York, Momoko at a confectionery school in Paris, Hana at the medical school of Tokyo University... and Doremi is studying hard for her second university entrance exam!　Each of them has different dreams and lives, but they are all connected, so they will never be alone anymore!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

116434.description: In the year 20XX, an organisation called “The Order” is aiming for world peace– by turning humans into monsters and uniting them in their new, grotesque forms. Enora, a teenage girl, is using her special powers to fight back.

116435.description:
We're asking the important questions here: what if Hungarian serial killer Elizabeth Báthory were a femboy?

(source: J18)

116450.description:
Coming from a mysterious place, the gray and red creatures collide on earth. They manage to transform as many humans as they can into their own kind. Xiao Cheng and Zheng Yiren, best friends from childhood, were transformed into red and gray respectively. Standing on opposite ideals, faced with this collapsing world, what choices will the two brothers make?

(Source: Mangatoon)

116451.description:
Thousands of years ago, the immortal clan and demon clan were battling for the universe. To defend the peace and justice, the immortal clan created a mysterious legendary fighter, who blew himself up into thousands of pieces, floating in the world. And Lu Xiaofei inherit a piece of the fighter.

(Source: Mangatoon)
synonyms: The Legend Of The demon God

116452.description: An ordinary student accidentally traveled into an other universe and became the king of a small kingdom. He had gotten a “Cheating Code” of life and was able to complete something extraordinary. This is the story about a king that was able to conquer continents and leave behind him an ultimate legend that will be recited between every generation to come.

116453.description: Surprise! Mu Tian Ran has been set up, his martial arts skills crippled at the hands of his own brother. Not only that, he's been rejected by his own family, who tortured him only to finally disown him and throw him out, all because he has the Bloodline of a Slave. At the lowest point of his life, a mysterious man arrives to mentor him and help him develop his own hidden talents. It turns out that his Bloodline, which was so repugnant to mankind, is actually a gift from the Heavens called the "Heavenly Demon Bloodline," making Mu Tian Ran an extremely rare child said to be favored by the gods themselves. As he grows stronger, Mu Tian Ran begins his journey to wreak vengeance on those who had shamed him in the past.

116454.description:
Having suffered humiliation in youth and then moving forward with exceptional martial talent, to inherit the role of the overlord,
to ride the king of demon beasts, break through all obstacles and seize back his family estate, ascend to the pinnacle of the martial arts world and flip the order of heavens!

116455.description: Yuu has been waiting for the release of the computer game White Earth, which was developed in total secrecy and had its release date postponed for unknown reasons. He finds out from some friends that he can download it from the game's official site, which results in a child coming out of his computer.
synonyms: ブラン　プロジエクト

116458.description:
After killing many monsters, Zhong Kui and his apprentice Qin Shuang found a bizarre connection between these monsters and their some odd setup. Finally they find out that someone is trying to set up an this kind of array in the capital.

(Source: Web Comics)

116459.description:
Within the Nine Prefectures, there are many kingdoms. Rumor has it that deep in the desolate lands, masters are as common as the clouds. They have the ability to go against their fates! Outside the Savage Beast Mountain Range, in a small city called Stone City, there is only one person who goes against the will of the heavens and changes his fate.

(Source: Managtoon)

116460.description: The world has plunged into a new threat. Alien creatures are wreaking havoc and there is only one team who can stop them. This is the story of valiant heroines fighting against these alien foes. Want to know more? Stay tuned, get ready, and watch them battle on!

title.native: オルタンシア・サーガ

116464.description: A desperate slave girl escapes into the deep forest, where the death-god resides.

title.native: 終の神, 言ノ葉の少女
title.romaji: Tsui no Kami, Kotonoha no Shoujo

116466.description: The northern powerhouse, Pravda Highschool, is on course to win the 62nd national senshadou championship! The tiny tyrant Katyusha and Nonna's battle begins! The curtain lifts on this spin-off to the smash-hit anime Girls und Panzer!
synonyms: Girls and Panzer: Saga of Pravda

title.native: ガールズアンドパンツァープラウダ戦記

116467.description:
A Hero is someone chosen by God to receive a supernatural 'gift'. A unique existence, only one Hero can exist at a time, with a new one being chosen upon the former's death.

This generation's Hero is a ordinary villager girl named Kyrie whose gift is merely being able to boil water.

When her family and friends are slaughtered, Kyrie is backed into a corner and learns the true value of that boiling hot power, and how well it could be used to fan the flames of revenge that burned inside of her.
synonyms: The Tale of the Teapot Hero's Revenge: Although a Hero Was Only Capable of Boiling Water, That Was Enough to Kill All of Those Who Stole Everything from Her

title.native: 湯沸かし勇者の復讐譚〜水をお湯にすることしか出来ない勇者だけど、全てを奪ったお前らを殺すにはこいつで十分だ〜
title.romaji: Yukashi Yuusha no Fukushuutan: Mizu wo Oyu ni suru Koto Shika Dekinai Yuusha dakedo, Subete wo Ubatta Omaera wo Korosu niwa Koitsu de Juubunda

116471.description:
Noah, a beautiful Alpha, is supposed to marry a female Alpha in order to keep the bloodline pure and is therefore forbidden to have contact to Omegas. One day he meets Hajime, a male Alpha just like himself, and falls in love with him at first sight. Though he knows their love has no future, they start a relationship. Is there still hope for a happy end or does Noah have to marry a female Alpha like his parents do wish for him?

Note: Includes the one-shot "Nicholas" (ニコラス).
synonyms: A Garden Filled at Night With Happiness

title.native: しあわせに満ちた夜の庭
title.romaji: Shiawase ni Michita Yoru no Niwa

116472.description:
Sugar Daddies are no foreign concept between older men and younger women... but what do you call it between two high school girls?! Follow Sachiko as she comes up with all sorts of shenanigans to milk money out of her girlfriend, Miho.

(Source: Irodori Comics)
synonyms: Mesukosei ga Mesukosei no Himo ni Naru Hanashi

title.native: 女子高生が女子高生のヒモになる話
title.romaji: Joushikousei ga Joushikousei no Himo ni Naru Hanashi

116474.description:
The manga centers on the members of Beit and The Kogadō as they audition for a musical set in Japan's Heian era.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: アイドルマスターSideM ストラグルハート

116475.description: Peace may have been restored to Hoenn after the evils schemes of Team Aqua, Team Magma and later Guile Hideout were put to rest. However, when a new crisis approached, Steve Stone had no choice but to enlist the help of Ruby, Sapphire and Emerald once again.

title.english: Pokémon Adventures: Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire
title.native: ポケットモンスターSPECIAL Ωルビー・αサファイア
title.romaji: Pocket Monsters SPECIAL: Omega Ruby & Alpha Sapphire

116476.description:
Sun dreams of money. Moon dreams of science. When their paths cross with Team Skull, both their plans go awry.

Moon is on her way to deliver a rare Pokémon to Professor Kukui in the Alola region when she meets his good friend Sun, a courier entrusted with a special Pokédex. Sun offers to safely deliver Moon to the professor’s lab…but then they tangle with a group of grunts from Team Skull and are attacked by a mysterious Pokémon!

What does the mysterious Pokémon leave in its wake…?

title.native: ポケットモンスターSPECIAL サン・ムーン

116477.description: The Sword & Shield chapter follows the adventures of Soudo Tsurugi and Shirudomiria Tate.

title.native: ポケットモンスターSPECIAL ソード・シールド

116478.description: Shiomi Yutori just graduated college but has only recently tasted ramen six months ago after coming back to Japan from the US and falling in love with it. She is incredibly talented in cooking, and has impeccable taste buds and food sense. She applies to the Serigawa Project, a company started by the famous ramen chef Serizawa Tatsuya that operates as a restaurant consulting company that focuses on ramen shops. Yutori is just as creative as she is blunt, even criticizing Serizawa’s ramen with its flaws. Although Yutori gets the job at the company, she will need more than creativity and cooking skills if she wants to master this job.

116479.description: A girl who is introverted and incompetent finds a bow in her room. After wearing it, she sees something unexpected... Adolescent feelings, afraid of discovery, and longing for new knowledge. My love for you because I like you. My gaze is on you and you only.

116481.description:
This manga is set in the aftermath of a great disaster, and depicts the struggle for survival of men.

(Source: Anime News Network)

116482.description:
"Are you going to spread your legs for me like you did for my brother?" After Louis was dumped by his boyfriend of many years, his ex-boyfriend's younger brother, Theo, appeared before him. Frustrated with Theo's relentless inquiring, and in spite of his dejection, Louis lied: "I was the one who broke up with your brother." That's when Theo started to follow him. "If my lie is uncovered, it'll all end. That's good." That must have been what he thought, but before he knew it, Theo’s obsession for him began.

Note: Includes 4 extra chapters.
synonyms: NEVER GOOD ENOUGH 永遠不夠好

116483.description:
In a chaotic world, the Chu kingdom's emperor Chu Yuan relied on his Lord of the Southwest Duan Baiyue for support. Together, they led the mighty army of the Chu, ten-million strong, into bloody battles. Until they finally united the country and make peace for the people, in this epic tale of blood and iron.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

116484.description:
Despite being from different social classes, Lady Melody is finally wed to her butler Alfred. They move to a new home in the countryside of Great Britain. What kind of happy newlywed life awaits them with their new neighbors?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)
synonyms: Bara Saku Oniwa de Ochakai wo
บันทึกรักคุณหนูไฮโซ งานเลี้ยงน้ำชาแสนหวาน ในสวนกุหลาบแสนรัก

title.native: メロディの事件簿 薔薇咲くお庭で<ローズガーデン>お茶会を
title.romaji: Melody no Jikenbo: Rose Garden de Ochakai wo

116485.description:
Shortly after the war ends, Tokuma works at a steel mill in Yahata, Fukuoka Prefecture. His older brother, Giichi, was killed in the war, and Tokuma marries Giichi's widow, Mahoko. But as he starts living with the woman he had long admired as his brother's wife, Tokuma finds that Giichi's presence still lingers in Mahoko's heart...! Tokuma struggles with whether he can ever move out of his brother's shadow. Can he and Mahoko ever become a "normal couple"? As they navigate their daily lives together, a love story unfolds—one filled with frustration, heartache, and innocent affection.

(Source: Shogakukan, machine translated and edited)

Note: Includes the one-shots "Atashi no Federica" and "Zetsubou ga Kikoeru".
synonyms: Tokuma & His Wife in the Steel Town

title.native: だんだん街の徳馬と嫁
title.romaji: Dandan Machi no Tokuma to Yome

116486.description: Im So Hee is adored by countless men, yet she is determined in her disbelief of true love. To her, true love is only fiction; something that is real only on paper. But, events start to twist and turn once she is involved in a traffic accident–the exact accident that leads her to meet a romance novelist. This novelist is not like any ordinary ones. synonyms: I'll Fall in Love with You

116558.description:
Kuzuta is going out with a yankee woman, Kurogawa, in a punishment game. He is also required to take a sneak shot by the bullies. However, one of them, Yuuji, was actually thinking about Kurogawa! The woman he admires is about to be fucked by Kuzuta's big dick...

Note: Released at Comic Market 92, 93, 94

title.native: 罰ゲームでヤンキー女に告ってみた
title.romaji: Batsu Game de Yankee Onna ni Kokuttemita

116559.description: Every day after leaving elementary school, Otone-chan visits the kind lady living near her home, since she can't play outside with her school friends due to her frail body. The two have a secret, though: They're lovers.

title.native: 近所のやさしいおねえさん

116560.description:
James Jung is the top student at Ozoh Academy, home of the gifted and mega rich. He is also an undercover agent protecting the principal from a dangerous assassin. His name? Samuel Gyo, codename black mamba and now James’ homeroom teacher. In order to fight, they must abide by three rules. First, they cannot have their identities exposed to the other students. Second, they cannot harm the students. Third and most importantly, no explosives or firearms. Poison and tranquilizers are fine. Fighting to the death, no one ever briefed them for the fourth and final rule: you must not fall in love. Will they break it?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes 10 extra chapter.

116561.description: As a closeted gay man, Gyulwoo is 28 and single. He has a decent job but he’s lacking in the love department, too terrified to come out and ruin his career or reputation. Ready to live the rest of his life hiding his feelings, Gyulwoo is shocked when Hojun, his old friend from high school, appears. In the past, Hojun had revealed he loved Gyulwoo but Gyulwoo wasn’t ready to accept his love. Decades later, will Gyulwoo keep their romance secret or will he finally share his heart with Hojun and the world?

116562.description:
Studying abroad in the US, Do-Jin has experienced his fair share of unexpected surprises. New schools, new people, new roommates. However, of all the surprises, Do-Jin never expected to catch his roommate’s handsome younger brother, Tae-Hui, jerking off to him in his sleep?! That’s when the scandal began…

(Source: Tapas, edited)

Note: Includes six extra chapters.
synonyms: บานาน่า สแกนเดิล

116564.description:
Yuki starts to live on her own when she starts working, but, there has been a mistake in contract, so she ended up living with her childhood friend, Keita. They don't get along very well, so they made some house rules, but Yuki has no idea the penalty for breaking a rule is so naughty!

(Source: Coolmic)
synonyms: Breaking the Rules, and I Have to Do What?!

title.english: A SECRET PENALTY: I STARTED TO LIVE WITH MY CHILDHOOD FRIEND
title.native: ルール違反はイクまでH!?～幼なじみと同居はじめました
title.romaji: Rule Ihan wa Iku made H!?: Osananajimi to Doukyo Hajimemashita

116565.description:
The darkness lurking behind the beautiful face. It's horribly exciting and you can't look away. Jun, a college student who's not good at socializing, was aiming to become a novelist while working part-time as a ghost writer. He was depressed because his work on the Internet wasn't appreciated, but suddenly he developed a strange possession (ghost) ability to see the other faces behind women. A beautiful apartment resident, an associate university professor, and... Within the darkness of women being exposed one after another, Jun takes up a brush and writes.

(Source: Amazon, translated)

116568.description: She is beautiful, persevering but what amazes people is her sharp mind. Sharp minded enough to become the next empress. However the prince despises her... How will she manage to make him fall in love with her?

116569.description: Yuuji's childhood friend Souichi is an office worker who is extremely busy with work. After meeting again, Yuuji begins to feed Souichi, healing his friend in the process. As these nights come by more and more often, the love that Yuuji has been keeping asleep within him slowly starts to simmer and reawaken.
synonyms: Yearn for Me, Burn for Me

title.native: 焦がれて焦がして

116570.description:
We're cooking up a scandal!

Washed-up singer Rosa is at the end of her rope. She's jobless, her agency's just about given up on her, and her boyfriend is a deadbeat. But what happens when she's suddenly invited on to the reality show Celeb Kitchen Battle? And how will she react to meeting her one true love?

(Source: Manta)

116571.description:
After defeating the demon lord, assassin Roland seems destined for eternal greatness, yet he wants nothing of the sort! Determined to avoid fame and fortune in pursuit of a normal life, he applies for a job at the local Adventurers Guild, where all manner of intrepid warriors come to turn in their quests. But Roland has no idea what “normal” really is, and he’s anything but your average employee! Will this world-class assassin be able to adjust to the monotony of everyday life at the guild?

(Source: Yen Press)
synonyms: The Guild Official With The Out-of-the-Way Skill “Shadowy” Is, In Fact, The Legendary Assassin

title.english: Hazure Skill: The Guild Member with a Worthless Skill Is Actually a Legendary Assassin
title.native: 外れスキル「影が薄い」を持つギルド職員が、実は伝説の暗殺者
title.romaji: Hazure Skill "Kage ga Usui" wo Motsu Guild Shokuin ga, Jitsuha Densetsu no Ansatsusha

116572.description:
Yuuki took in Nono, a succubus who failed at job hunting, and decided to let her stay at his house.
Nono is not good at sex even though she is a succubus. But that is why the two have a pure relationship.
A chaste pure-love comic that will make you smile!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Note: Originally self-published on Twitter, the series was collected for commercial publication with first volume released on 2021-02-27.

title.romaji: Sensei no Oyome-san ni Naritai Onna no Ko wa Minna 16-sai dayo?

116576.description:
A tale of friendship between two girls who take care of each other.

The short Koike Natsuo is often mistaken for a primary school student. The tall Amano Oriko is often mistaken for a handsome young man. These two may not look it, but they're both 20 year old female college students! A spin-off from Dekoboko Girlish, Oriko to Nattsun is the story of friendship and perseverance. The two have just started to live together, but they mean more to each other than anything else.

(Source: AlabastreAizo)

116577.description: Crossing, or a substitute? The ancient female hero's Hua Mulan traveled to the present world through time and space, and found that Xiao Li feng was exactly the same as the dead Xiangfan. Is this a coincidence of history? Or is it the meaning of her miraculous crossing? For this reason, Mulan became Xiao’s little assistant and small nanny, and the two began to live together in a fun and interesting life.

title.native: 亭主元気でマゾがいい！
title.romaji: Teishu Genki de Maso ga Ii!

116579.description: A young girl who pretends to be a male god, a black-shouldered younger brother and a pretending to be a lady, is a hard-working model of campus life that strives to keep people from falling apart. In the mutual transformation and mutual supervision, they gradually began to face up to the true self, and love also came quietly. You can live the way you like.

title.romaji: Xue Zhang Di Xiao Nü Xin

116590.description:
Four years ago, Kirika Amano's older brother became a shut-in. Since then, he's barely even left his own room, constantly working on something at his desk. When Kirika finally finds out what he's been doing all that time, she's shocked -- her brother creates boys love comics! Not only that, but it turns out that he's actually quite good at it, and he's got a dedicated fanbase.

Even though Kirika doesn't understand her brother's hobbies or the fandom that surrounds him, he's still family. Maybe if she helps him sell his comics, she can convince him to step outside into the world again and greet his fans in person.

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

synonyms: ばけもの茶処（かふぇ）、いらっしゃいませ。

title.native: ばけもの茶処、いらっしゃいませ。
山中鹿介物語-尼子再興記-

116594.description: Xia XiaoShu used to be a rebellious girl who was once involved in violence incidents at school. After she transferred to a different school, she tried to change her image to "Good Girl" in desire of having a normal school life. However, she was once again targeted by her previous "rival". If she did not fight back, her secrets will be exposed. If she does not fight back, her friends will be harmed... Having to choose between "Good Girl" and "Bad Girl", what will she do?

116595.description:
A life of high school student when his hidden secret as a housewife almost is revealed.

Season 1: 29 chapters

116596.description: The manga follows Shindou Yoriko, a 29-year-old Kyoto cigarette shop owner who has a sharp look in her eyes but is actually a kind-hearted person. It may not come across, but she truly loves the city of Kyoto, and is willing to give up some of her time to share that love with tourists and other visitors.

title.native: はんなりギロリの頼子さん

116597.description: Damwoon's sudden allergy to chlorine forces him to give up his swimming career, but when he develops an allergy to his best friend Haesoo, will he be able to give him up too?

116598.description: As punishment for falling in love with a human and saving her life, a god was cursed for eternity to live as a human in an unaging form while reincarnating over and over. To stay by his side, Kazusa, the human he fell in love with, requested that she be afflicted with a similar curse. Her wish was granted with the condition that she cannot let him know about her identity or curse.

116599.description:
No money, but people who are born with something comfortable to live in ~

(Source: Daum Webtoon, translated)

116600.description:
For hopeless romantic Ginger Torte, getting engaged to the man of her dreams is a fairy tale come true. It isn’t long before she realizes the gut-wrenching truth — her fiancé has been seduced by her rival! The heartbroken Ginger finds solace in a new book that recounts the tale of a young woman and a cursed prince… But to her horror, the protagonist turns out to be none other than her beautiful nemesis, Lerazie! As reality unfolds according to the book, both ladies fall in love with the handsome prince at first sight. Ginger vows to steal both the spotlight and the prince’s heart! But, does this story harbor a sinister secret?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: The chapter count includes 10 extra stories.
synonyms: นางเอกอย่างเธอ ต้องเจอนางร้ายอย่างฉัน

116601.description:
Peaceful life in a perfectly constructed town bores ten-year-old Nico into mischief. Riding Creepers while they explode is fun and all, but what he really wants is to escape the blocky confines of his home and take his crafting skills on an adventure to the ends of the world. Just how big is the world, anyway, and what could possibly stand in his way?

(Source: VIZ Media)
synonyms: Minecraft: A Journey to the End of the World
マインクラフト: 世界の旗の旅
Minecraft: Viagem Ao Fim Do Mundo

title.romaji: MINECRAFT: Sekai no Hate no Tabi

116602.description: Section Chief Tanaka is a zealous 30-year old who works at Oote Food's advertising group, is suddenly turned tiny! Yamada, a cool subordinate is tasked to look after Chief Tanaka and is very much envied by his colleagues.

116603.description:
Dahye always felt sorry for the villainess character Violet from the novel "For Shannon," who tragically pursues a one-sided love for Earhart, the hero. After waking up in Violet's body, Dahye sees her chance to ditch the story's love triangle and declares her feelings for Earhart are no more. Her next mission is to save Violet's childhood friend Haron from similar heartbreak by making sure he doesn't fall for the heroine, Princess Shannon. But now Earhart has suddenly confessed a renewed love for Violet, and the normally kind Shannon has become vindictive towards her. Can "Violet" and Haron find their own happily ever after, amidst all the unexpected drama and confusion? Based on the hit novel.

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: นางร้ายสกัดรัก

116606.description:
It's a world ruled by cards. Chen Mu is a one-star card maker and he got a precious card in a second-hand store by chance. By learning card making theory during the day and studying the precious card at night, he makes rapid progress on card making, and his card is valued by the top student from Dongwei Academy. His life is going through changing without being noticed!

(Source: Webnovel)

title.native: 私と友達はよくキスをする
title.romaji: Watashi to Tomodachi wa Yoku Kiss wo Suru

116611.description:
Before starting a new job at a prestigious company, Yoo Juha happily jets off on a vacation with her girlfriend, Kim Minsung. But when people from Minsung's past show up and reveal that she used to be a genius hacker, Juha realizes she's being used as a pawn in a secret project planned by the company executives. In order to expose the scheme and protect Minsung, Juha joins hands with a mysterious duo who offer their help, but will the power of love be enough to win this battle of deception?

(Source: Tapas)

title.native: 偉大なる、しゅららぼん
みならい女神 プルプルんシャルム

116614.description:
In the story, "Jinrui Metsubou" has passed judgment on humanity. The lone warrior who intends to rebel against the decision meets a man from the human world.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: 軌道の鎧 レイルゴースト

116615.description:
Tsukigakure is a brothel selling one-night dreams, and is the only place that employs male courtesans. Among them, Mitsuo is particularly popular, and is also known as a "virgin courtesan" who does not sleep with customers. What is the reason that Mitsuo continues to remain a virgin despite being a courtesan?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

116617.description: War between the kingdom of Ragnanival, led by the king Odin, and the realm of Ringford, led by the queen Elfaria has devastated the country of Valentine, of which only scattered ruins remain. The story is told from the perspective of five characters whose stories intertwine: Gwendolyn, valkyrie and younger daughter of Odin; Cornelius, prince of the neutral country of Titania; Mercedes, daughter of Elfaria and princess of Ringford; Oswald, a shadow knight and agent of Ringford; and Velvet, a survivor of Valentine's devastation.
synonyms: オーディンスフィア レイヴスラシル

title.native: オーディンスフィア ちいさな妖精女王

116619.description:
Everything is surely connected, isn’t it? For Hoshino, life after graduation would mean not being able to see his teacher Ms Tsukioka again, even if she is just a simulation—or is she? If Ms. Tsukioka is a real person and actually exists, does Hoshino have the courage to find her and express his feelings to her? Waiting in the Classroom is the extraordinary story of an unordinary school, a teacher that only appears when the students are sleeping, and an ordinary boy in search of a deeper connection.

(Source: Manga Club)

116621.description: A romantic comedy where Tomoyuki is married to a demon for a wife, a literal honest to goodness demon.
synonyms: What I Get for Marrying a Demon Bride

title.native: 鬼嫁と結婚してしまった結果
title.romaji: Oniyome to Kekkon Shite Shimatta Kekka

116623.description:
Having been raised in the mountains away from civilization for 13 years, Kenichi finally makes his return to the the city! His raw strength causes damage wherever he goes- not to mention, tons of laughs in this comedy like none other!

(Source: Weekly Shonen Jump Exhibition Vol.1 Catalog)

Included one-shots:
Volume 17: Moeru! Oniisan (Pilot), Boku no Tomodachi P.2
Volume 18: Super Otousan

116624.description:
Naturally, I'll show you I know my stuff. ♥

(Source: FAKKU)

116625.description:
What does this pretty girl want with me? To marry me? That won't do... What about this pretty lady? You wanna marry me too? Tsk tsk, since when did I become so in demand?

(Source: Bilibili Comics)
synonyms: My Wife Is a Fox Spirit

116627.description: Follow the daily life of Kasumi, a girl whose expressions don't show on her face, and her friend, Fumi.

116628.description:
In the Kingdom of Xia, the grand-general's daughter Situ Xiu is a strange girl who is weak, timid, and stutters, too! One day, her twin brother the young general got mad and suddenly left home… Not knowing the situation, the emperor ordered her brother to lead a military expedition to defend the border! Miss Situ must grit her teeth and pretend to be her brother. Now she is forced to face off against Can Yu, Sha Kingdom's mightiest general, the one they call the War God's reincarnation…

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue and an extra chapter.

116629.description:
The story takes place in mountain village where a girl has not been born in 50 years. A group of female college students visit the village and a bizarre murder case unfolds.

(Source: Anime News Network)

116630.description: Suzumoriya Co., Ltd. is a Jam company whose the president is still elementary schooler. This is a comedy depicting the interaction between the loli president and the employees on this stage.

title.native: アイドルマスター ミリオンライブ！ Blooming Clover
title.romaji: The iDOLM@STER Million Live!: Blooming Clover

116633.description:
Having mastered the art of lying her way through life, Yeon-Hui Bae has vowed to leave her past behind and make a fresh start for herself by going to college at 24. But when she runs into someone who knows a secret from her past that could completely ruin her reputation, her hopes for a perfect life suddenly start to crumble. Amidst college gossip, crushes, and jealousy, can the two set aside their differences and embrace each other for who they really are?

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

116634.description:
I want to eat delicious food... but if I eat it, I'll get fat...
In that case, all I have to do is exercise as much as I eat!

116636.description:
After being overworked to death, Ronia was reincarnated as a villainess in a certain novel world. She knows that her engagement will be cancelled and she will be banished from the center stage. However, she wants to spend a peaceful and relaxing time in this world! After being banished according to the novel, Ronia opens a coffee shop in the countryside with the help of small fairies called Loto. Then, unique beastmen come to her shop one after another...? This is a relaxing life of a former villainess!!

(Source: Alpha Manga)

116637.description:
A woman dies on her way to a martial arts competition and wakes up as a rich young lady.

At first, I was a martial genius and only wanted to become a hero but due to hunger, I ended dying. When I opened my eyes again, I had reincarnated as a weak lady and worse, she isn't just rumored to have to marry the young master of Fu but also an annoying fan of the city's most handsome man. She is known as arrogant and bossy, hated by all. HOW IS SHE SUPPOSED TO BECOME A HERO LIKE THIS! Thankfully, there is a martial artist around, so I must absolutely get on his good side! Huh? This dude seems to dislike me...
synonyms: I Want to Become a Heroic Swordswoman!

116638.description:
A manga that depicts the life-changing story of the employees working in a heartless corporation after they've all turned into...cats? o_O
Nya-lyfe is really full of ups and downs, and it's impossible to prepare for it nya? Well, this is my story...

A Black Company's Employee Became a Cat, a Life-Changing Story
Black Company's Employees Become Cats, Life Changed Story

title.romaji: Black Kigyou no Shain ga Neko ni Natte Jinsei ga Kawatta Hanashi

116639.description:
High school graduation ceremony marks the end of one's youth. As the elder of the twins, Itsuki had "the best" ceremony surrounded by his friends and girlfriend. Alternatively the younger twin, Haruka, had "the worst" ceremony, having to spend the time on the roof alone.

During the ceremony, the two accidentally fell from the roof. To their surprise, they were both brought back to the entrance ceremony of their high school. From there, the two's "best" and "worst" youth had been replaced.

116640.description: Some girls from the same department are approaching me for some reason! But there is a reason why she can’t get out of hand…
synonyms: Senpai! Let's Have an Office Romance♪

116643.description: On the day of his high school entrance ceremony, Rei is suddenly assailed by a feeling of languor. When he wakes up, he finds that his surroundings are filled with things that could not be called human. In a town where strange phenomena continues to stretch, a group of lonely youths have their encounter.

116649.description:
Mizuki Kouichi is about to take his final exams and graduate from high school when he suddenly finds himself transported to a fantasy world–specifically, to a kingdom of titans! The country’s beautiful denizens are almost twice the size of Kouichi, who was a tall basketball star back home. To his surprise, one of the giants, Prince Caius, claims Kouichi as his bride! Due to a dire prophecy, the prince’s upcoming nuptials cannot be with anyone of his world, so he’s happy to take Kouichi as his “wife.” What starts as big trouble for Kouichi turns into a grand romantic adventure when he finds out that Caius truly has a lot of love to give.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title.native: 深沢さん、ありがとう。

116652.description:
While everyone knows the story of the sea, no one knows the story of the deep sea.
Minato Wadatsumi was born and raised in a port town. But unfortunately for him, he has an extreme phobia of fish. One day, Minato comes across a fish out of water that changes his life.

116653.description:
In this world, on the day that they reach adulthood, everyone visits the temple to receive their life's calling. Many will become warriors or magic users. But when the frail younger brother of a minor feudal lord named Arsrod goes in for his job, he comes out with...Oda Nobunaga?! Not only has that job never been heard of, not a single person can even figure out what it's supposed to mean. But when this young man inherits the experience, tactics, and prowess in war of the great Sengoku strategist Nobunaga, his very destiny will change!

(Source: Yen Press)

116658.description: Kurono Crawford, a noble of Cepheus Empire had a secret. It was that he came from a different world... modern Japan. Having the knowledge about the modern weapons and his sense of values, he was an existence almost like a cheat, aiming to be the Harem king. Abandoned by his superiors, left in command of the Empire's rejects consisting of demi-humans such as Minotaur's, Dwarfs, and Elves, and thrust into a position as head of a poor fiefdom, Kurono will do everything he can to rebuild and strengthen his forces and revitalize the land, aided in part by his knowledge of the other world.

So when he finds out she’s actually a witch, Haruka swears he’ll do whatever it takes to help her graduate from magic school—even if it means cross-dressing as a girl! Allergic to the stinks of the world, there's no place in the world for him to feel safe and composed except his house which his grandfather keeps clean. One day, he got caught up in an accident that will disturb his not-so-quiet life, and now he has to kiss to survive?!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

116671.description:
In order to defeat several non-human monsters, the boy also became something non-human.

Shin Uruma, a sixth-grade student, was named "Experimental body: A" by five of his classmates and was severely bullied and lived in hell. His only peace was with his brother, who loved him, and his parents, who protected him.... . until the five monsters killed his family. When he finally loses everything and faces true hell, a dark "wish" is born inside Shun. He was reborn under the training of his grandfather, who served in a secret unit during WWII. Now, four years later, he appears in front of his fated enemy.

Well… everyone but Jung Si-Woo that is… At least that was his fate until he saved Su Ah-rin, an awakened player who is now bound to Si-Woo as his personal healer! With Ah-rin by his side, Si-woo just may break into the player’s life after all!

(Source: Tapas, edited)

116677.description:
Kanade is an office worker who's unfulfilled in life...and keeps the fact that he's gay a secret. Everything changes when he reunites with an old classmate from high school: Mashiro, the boy Kanade secretly liked back in his youth. Mashiro's arrival seems to bring new sunlight to Kanade's dreary life. As they get to know each other again as adults, could this be Kanade's chance to find love with the one who got away?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

For the clock of this village, everything was going perfectly well until she meets a young boy from the next village. The young boy tells her about the clock from his village, a clock that doesn’t talk to anyone. What is the secret behind these living clocks, and what connection does the clock from the next village?

116718.description:
Maeda Kaname, a former classroom teacher, travels to a war-torn country in order to meet a student to whom he's been teaching Japanese online. Amongst the fighting and confusion he meets the leader of the anti-government guerrilla, John, and they end up helping each another. Why is it that John, who has placed himself on the front lines, seems to age and rejuvenate every time Maeda looks at him?

A story of life and death on the battlefield.

(Source: Akaneshinsha, translated, edited)

116719.description:
In a world where only men can use magic, Eco is able to use magic for some reason despite being a woman. Even though I lived hiding that, unexpected things make magical things look like ballet. A cousin proposed “Do you want to work as a magician in the Ministry of Magic instead?” I can not even continue to live in this place, Eco decides to become a mage by falsifying her gender. However, if you go to the Magic Ministry, you’ll be in trouble with strange colleagues and funny incidents – !? The ill-fated work fantasy of the mage​ will start its long-awaited commercialization!

When he awakens, he finds a beautiful silver-haired young woman named Riselia standing before him. More shockingly, Leonis has been transformed into a ten-year-old boy! Now he’ll have to adapt to this strange era and deal with the twisted monsters called Voids-all while keeping his true powers a secret from his lovely new guardian.

(Source: Yen Press)

116723.description:
Outgoing and popular Kazu and shy and serious Moto grew up together as childhood best friends. But something changes during junior high, and the familiar, easy rhythm of their friendship begins to break apart as Kazu starts nursing deeper feelings for his oblivious friend. When Kazu's troubled home life and Moto's budding romantic forays create a clash of misunderstandings, secrets, and hurt feelings, will their relationship be able to survive these growing pains?

Welcome Back, Aureole is a bittersweet yet tender exploration of the maturation of young love. Two boys growing up side by side... their stars drift apart and come together again.

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

Kishida, a serious office-worker who loves his job, but every Wednesday at 12, his other job begins. That is, to make lunch for Towa, an easy-going girl who often gets sucked into her work and forgets to eat.

Pancakes in Hawaii, steamed buns in a far-away nightlife, on the way home from work, ramen and beer that make you smile. Food meets wonderful situations. Enjoying delicious food with you in the best places imaginable. This is the story of a Wednesday that connects lunch and love!

Yukino, who worked as store manager of a cosmetics store, enjoyed and was good at her job, but still felt that something was missing. When shopping one day, she helps out what appears to be a tourist and ends up spending the night with him. He was like a cute cat wanting to be spoiled, until he suddenly locked her in his passionate gaze....

After dating for a year, my boyfriend confesses to me that he has super power. Not only can he be summoned by me anytime and anywhere, he also does whatever I want him to!

Bong Sunhwa is an average company employee frustrated by the business of life. One evening she receives a call from her mother asking her to come down to her hometown to clean up the old things she had left behind. As she makes her way home and rummages through her mess she reminisces about her past when love was sweet, yet so distant.

Not long after, she decides to drop by an old book store she used to visit as a student. Not only did it change into a trendy cafe, but the owner as well…?

An award-winning short story manhwa for the youthful heart!

116731.description:
The hit series from Eun Song returns with officially updated artwork, chapters, and additional scenes! With the sudden outbreak of a deadly virus, humanity is thrown into chaos. The few who survive it are either transformed into horrible cannibalistic creatures called "Worms," or super-humans called "Anomalies." Haru, a young Anomaly student at New Seoul High School, dreams of joining the prestigious "ISO" - an organization formed to fight the war against this virus. But the future in store for him is nothing like he imagined...

(Source: Tappytoon)

116732.description:
Sol-A is a normal university student. Suddenly her boring student life is about to change when she takes in a cat named Hong-Jo. What kind of secret does her cat Hong-Jo have and what will happen to Sol-A's life because of it?

A Sparrow's Hotel story in full comic form instead of 4-koma.

The comedy revolves around Sayuri Satou, the new front desk worker at the Sparrow's Hotel— "the closest hotel to Heaven". Her special features are her large breasts and her skills of assassination. She takes down people who cause trouble in the business hotel with those skills, but she is in fact very unskilled when talking to the male hotel manager, and often bites her tongue.

When Cavo rescues Liam from an unfortunate situation in the forest, the paths of the monster and the beast cross for the first time. An explosion leaves Nam Kang orphaned, scarred, and nearly blind, but he toughs out the daily bullying with the help of his imaginary blob friend, Inky. Until one day, Nam wakes from a bad beating to find his scars healed and his vision restored. At a new school, Nam is finally given the chance to live life as a normal kid. But it isn’t just his scars that have disappeared. His best friend Inky is gone, too.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

A hot-blooded prosecutor, Kim Hi Wu, was murdered and sunk into the ocean while chasing the tyrant who controlled korea. But, Kim Hi Wu, meets a grim reaper who gives him a chance to relive and sends him back to when he was 18 years old. As a high schooler, Kim Hi Wu, prepares to punish the tyrant Jo Tae Sup.

She had been falsely accused of harassing a girl called Terenezza, daughter to a baron, whom the Prince doted on heavily.

In that time, the heroes made use of their abilities to contribute greatly to the development of the world. Longing to meet again with the master they admired, they reported to him of their achievements in detail. Ayane, a former No. 1 cabaret girl in Kabukicho, is tired of hustling in the city and she moves back home to idle around her parents' house. She is reluctantly forced by her mother to help out at her family's "snack bar." With her experience and charm, she is overwhelmingly successful, and the bar becomes abuzz with people drinking and singing. Then, Jun, a classmate who claims to be her ex-boyfriend, shows up...

Their experience with the "night life" will revitalize Asahimachi, Yonago City, and eventually Tottori as a whole!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

116811.description:
Berta’s marriage was suddenly arranged, she will become the second consort of the King. The current royal family values lineage above all else, with several generations of consanguineous marriages, to preserve its “purity.” The politics of the Kingdom, following the idea of the pureblood noblemen’s superiority, caused national power to decline. To retain the power of the Kingdom, the Royal Family decided to take a desperate measure, a marriage with a woman from the ethnic group to which belongs the majority of the population. The bitterness of this act… Those who were previously considered a subjugated group of people living on the frontiers.

The chosen bride is Berta, the first daughter of the current lord of Kasha, the largest estate on the frontier and also a powerful faction. The marriage life started in hard mode, a husband that doesn’t love her, a Queen that hates her, however, she still is forced to fulfil her role duties. Berta has decided to endure the hardship, that was already expected by her, and wait for the day when there’s no more need of her in the palace, and she can return home. However, Berta’s initial plans are ruined by an unexpected situation. After passing three nights with the King, as the royal rules dictated for a newlywed bride, Berta got pregnant with His Majesty’s child!!

Leah finds herself face-to-face with the reality that she will need to act as the temporary head of her family in order to protect their position in society. (Source: Netcomics)

116844.description:
An aloof young man will reset the world with a young girl he meets by fate.

A futuristic world where particles related to time and space have been discovered. An aloof and remarkable soldier who lived through the third world war, Hazama Yuuhi, joins the genius scientist Oshidori Keina for a secret experiment. Directly following, Yuuhi and Keina lose their lives to a mysterious attacker. After waking up again, he notices he has traveled back to a time before the the start of the experiment. In the midst of their experience with the death looping phenomena, his bond with Keina gradually grows stronger as they continue to unravel the mysteries before them. Will Yuuhi be able to save Keina from the despairs of death and prevent the future from being thrown into chaos?

(Source: HJ Bunko, translated)

By the time Katsutoshi realized he was in love, it ended as quickly as it began. Having been hurt so badly with his first few romantic experiences in life, he vowed never to get serious with anyone ever again. He’s made this very clear, especially to this old fart keep showing up wherever he goes! So why does it feel like fate is bringing them together?

116971.description:
The beautiful daughter of the Farnese family is caught up in a whirlwind romance with a notorious royal playboy -- it’s the scandal of the century! When the title of “Elvynee Deer” is awarded to the pure and lovely Ingrid Farnese, all of high society expects her to marry into foreign royalty. Cursed in love with a history of broken engagements, Ingrid is determined to stay put at home in Valentine Kingdom. To take control of her own future she'll make the king's illegitimate son, libertine and womanizer Regan Espencer, propose to her. But the problem is, Regan is the only man in the country who doesn’t want her hand in marriage! Will Ingrid survive being tossed into the throes of debauchery and reach her happy ending?

(Source: Tappytoon)

But as they both approach the final stretch of high school, they get a silly, totally-not-serious idea— what if they actually started dating? What a ridiculous thing to say! Unless…?

(Source: Yen Press)

116988.description:
Aah, if I had do it all again, I'd rather die. Adventurer Lughys spent his days as a loser. Opporessed by his party members, so called "comrades", the road to being a hero or a legend was a long ways away. Then suddenly, a mysterious shadow called out for him, giving him the chance to return to his past, and told him he'd be given only one chance.

He longed for it—— This time, he'd obtain valor and honor, and love.

However, the god of fate would not permit it. A battle with a great magical beast, an attack on a noble house, challenging a quest with the hero—— For far and away from his expectations, he gets entagled after rescuing someone. Unbeknownst to him, his dream took a 180, and from the girls in his former party, came a twisted attachment and affection.

There's only one chance at this. ——Now, why not take back the future? Revenge dwelling in a dark, hot flame, and turning the tables in a Replay Fantasy.

But just when he was about to reach the peak of his life, he found that there was more than one ring in his dream!? For the sake of the mysterious seal, he had to kill the other ring holders...

116990.description:
At least this much is "normal," is it not?

Elma who was raised in a prison was dangerously granted pardon and released. Though she tries to heed her mother's words to be "normal," while working as a maid in the royal palace, her outlandish abilities and behavior end up shaking it up in its entirety. Successfully carrying out a four person's job in one morning, tea that would taste as if it was blessed by the heavens if she brewed it, dissembling a giant tuna with one stroke of a sword, and even with a surgical procedure more advanced than recovery magic as her forte. --if not a little dangerous, even this normal is it not?

The curtain opens on a story of a thoughtlessly peerless girl who had intended to be normal.

116992.description:
In the not too distant future, a mysterious disaster has brought collapse to the world as we know it. Towering skyscrapers, once symbols of prosperity, are now lifeless graves of humanity's past pierced by the Thorns of Judgment. At the center of the destruction lies a hidden society of Revenants called Vein. This final stronghold is where the remaining few fight to survive, blessed with Gifts of power in exchange for their memories and a thirst for blood. Give into the bloodlust fully and risk becoming one of the Lost, fiendish ghouls devoid of any remaining humanity.

The manga's spinoff story centers on the Revenant Louis, who is also known as Sekiken (Red Sword).

(Source: Anime News Network)
